notes.title: StarCrawlers Patch Notes - 8/19/2016
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/hhSDQzo.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]PAX West 2016[/b][/h1]
We’re excited to announce we’re off to PAX West to show StarCrawlers in the Indie Megabooth! If you’re attending PAX, stop by and say “hi!” to get some sweet loot (maybe something in-game too, if you’re savvy :D) As we’ll be heading out of town next Friday, we’re dropping a mini-patch today with some new content, systems, and bug fixes. Dig in!

[h1][b]The Black Market[/b][/h1]
Draal has been sprucing up the Black Market with some additional amenities: 

Part I: Draal now accepts any passcodes you might find while crawling (or exploring in real life) and rewards you with unique items. Keep your eyes peeled! Speaking of which, you can follow us on Twitter: [h1][b]@Juggernaut_News[/b][/h1]

Part II (Coming Soon) : High Value items looted on runs will have expanded value outside of selling for hard credit (though you’ll still be able to do that too) and may trigger unique events...

[h1][b]Favor[/b][/h1]
To clear up some confusion around factions and reputation vs. favor, we’ve exposed the favor stat. Favor is accrued with factions that you have a Valued or higher rep with and can be exchanged for rewards by contacting the faction through the Wire Terminal on the station. The amount you currently have (up to a maximum of 10) can be viewed in the Info Log or at the Wire Terminal. If you’ve got a lot banked, call up the faction and see what they can do for you!

[h1][b]Systems[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Wire Terminal and Info Log now display accrued Favor with factions.
[*] The Favor cost of a reward is shown when selecting a reward option in a Wire contact event.
[/list]

[h1][b]Factions[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Horizon can now help with negative rep with Rhyzohm and Emer LT in exchange for favor.
[*] Riggo’s Fine Liquours can now be contacted from the Wire Terminal (but don’t expect them to be much help - yet).
[/list]

[h1][b]Hacker[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Implemented all ranks of Timed Release.
[*] Hacker Optimizations abilities & effects now correctly apply to all allies and NPCs.
[*] Ex Machina (Rank 3) now reduces the duration of all negative effects on allies.
[*] Optimization now increases all damage caused for allies by 2% (down from 3%).
[/list]

[h1][b]Cyberninja[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Abilities in the Combination tree that utilize punches & kicks to deal physical damage no longer require a melee weapon equipped.
[*] Ambush can now trigger up to 3/4/5 times per turn but now only triggers when allies dodge.
[*] Ambush (Rank 2) now reduces the Time Units of the Cyberninja by 10 with each activation.
[*] Ambush now correctly requires a melee weapon equipped to activate.
[*] Replaced Laserchain Kunai with Cyclone Kick.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Cyclone Kick. Sends the Cyberninja flying through the battlefield and delivers a powerful kick attack to any enemy the Cyberninja passes in the timeline when the ability is activate. Cyclone Kick cannot miss and cannot be dodged.
[*] Takedown now strikes all enemies with Combo Points.
[/list]

[h1][b]Events[/b][/h1][list]
[*] New events added for Mines.
[*] New events options added for Dirty Moves Smugglers.
[/list]

[h1][b]UI[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Newer model medkits have improved instructions printed on them.
[*] Fixed mail loading incorrectly when loading a save from STIX.
[*] Fixed highlight masking on Save / Load menu.
[*] Scrollbars should now correctly respond to the scrollwheel in all instances. If you spot a scrollbar that isn’t behaving correctly, please let us know!
[/list]

[h1][b]Items[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Certain rare accessories can now have combat abilities attached to them. If you equip one you’ll see an extra icon on the Ability Wheel in combat that will allow you to activate its ability.
[/list]

[h1][b]Misc Fixes[/b][/h1][list]
[*] It is no longer possible to assign Ability Points to a dead crawler.
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon[/b][list]
[*] Black Market (Part II) - Auctioning off those Hot Items.
[*] More unique gear.
[*] More friendly faction contact events.
[*] More cool stuff!
[/list]


Psst...
817D2-573F1-71AF2

notes.title: StarCrawlers Patch Notes - 8/12/2016
notes.notes:
The latest update has docked! Here's what's happening...

We heard you like fleeing, so now you can attempt to flee from combat. If you are successful at fleeing, you’ll have a short window of opportunity to put some distance between you and the mob before it can engage you in combat again. This is an experimental system, so please share feedback on how it feels.

In a hurry? We’ve also added an option in the Controls menu to speed up combat animations - please note this will cause audio synch issues, so use at your own discretion.

There’s a ton of bug fixes, balance tweaks, and other fun stuff too. Dive in!

[h1][b]Systems[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Added option to speed up combat animations in the ESC -> Options -> Controls menu.
[*] Added Flee ability to combat. This ability is available to all characters and is selected from the Ability wheel.
[*] Your chance of successfully fleeing is calculated based on your team’s aggregate gear (faster & lighter equipment = better odds), status effects on enemies (Stuns, Blinds, Charms, etc), and other factors (is it a boss, rare spawn, etc).
[*] Bosses, event encounters, and certain unique mobs prevent or reduce the chance of fleeing.
[*] Failing to flee will Daze all allies for 2x the Time Unit cost of their weapon.
[*] Successfully fleeing from combat will give you 5 turns to flee from the mob in Explore mode. Reentering a tile next to the mob will restart combat. Run for it!
[*] Fleeing reduces your chances of fleeing again from the same encounter by 20%.

notes.title: StarCrawlers Patch Notes 7/29 - Belly of the Beast
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Cm9pZT5.gif[/img]
The next story mission has arrived: Belly of the Beast! We hope you enjoy it :D 
This will be the last story mission released while StarCrawlers is in development - the final missions will launch with version 1.0. With all of the released story missions available we’ll be switching our focus back to itemization, abilities, and balance. Huge thanks as always to everyone who has been submitting reports and feedback!

[h1][b]Engine[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Upgraded StarCrawlers to Unity 5.3.6.
[*] Linux users should see improvement in audio / startup related crashes from the engine update.
[*] Various optimizations and improvements from the engine update.
[/list]

[h1][b]Abilities[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Abilities that attack using the caster weapon are noted in the ability tooltip.
[/list]

[h1][b]Cyberninja[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Abilities in the Deception tree now all correctly require a non-Heavy weapon to use.
[*] Fixed an issue that cause Shadowfall to fail to count CP on a target when applying its accuracy debuff.
[/list]

[h1][b]Soldier[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Fixed an issue where (believe it or not) Bomblets could cause a soft-lock in combat if they were added by Magnetronc Bomb / Bouncing Betty / UXO while trying to update Bomblets.
[/list]

[h1][b]Hacker[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Mindmelt cast by Black Ice now correctly deals Nanite damage when attacking.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause DoTs to deal 0 damage if the Hacker was killed.
[/list]

[h1][b]Smuggler[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Double Down now adapts to deal the element type of the Smuggler’s weapon.
[/list]

[h1][b]Prototype[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Reduced Time Unit cost of H.A.M to 50% weapon speed, damage to 49/50/51% weapon damage, and increased accuracy loss to 6/4/2% with each attack.
[/list]

[h1][b]Enemies[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Reduced base elemental damage for Plop, Crabby, and Grinder.
[*] Fixed chance that Copbot Rookies could soft-lock thinking they had no action to take.
[*] Frenzy damage dealing for Mites & Mite Swarms is no longer tied to their animation to address possible issues with the ability animation being interrupted.
[*] Fixed issue causing Mites to deal an extra hit at increased damage when using Frenzy.
[/list]

[h1][b]Items[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Loot containers in explore mode once again have a chance to drop random gear (Weapon, Armor, Shields, Accessories) in addition to credit loot.
[*] Loot from defeated mobs has an increased chance to include random gear.
[*] Worms and Mites now drop meaty credit loot and items.
[*] Several humanoid enemies now drop credit loot and items.
[*] The rarity odds for items on higher difficulty levels increases as your party level increases.
[*] Pistols are no longer generated with the Combat Initiative stat but instead have a new stat, Zeroing, which increases accuracy of weapon attacks against a target with each miss until a hit occurs.
[*] SMGs are no longer generated with the Aggression stat but instead have a new stat, Hyperburst, which reduces the dodge chance of targets when using a weapon attack. Dodge chance cannot be reduced below 0.
[*] SMGs / Pistols generated before these change will retain their original stats.
[*] Shield Breaker, Shield Pierce, Armor Pierce, Critical Damage Boost, and Hyperburst on weapons will now only be applied if the ability attacks using the caster’s weapon.
[*] Shield Pierce on melee weapons slightly reduced for Common & Uncommon rarities.
[/list]

[h1][b]Environment[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Simplified the security sector puzzle in the mission Triangulatin’.
[*] Fixed collision issues with trip beams in The Train Job mission.
[*] Fixed issue that could cause fire hazards to not deal damage at intervals (they still have a slight grace period so you can not stand in the fire).
[*] Gas traps now display a particle effect to warn of an active gas trap in a room before entering.
[/list]


[h1][b]UI[/b][/h1][list]
[*] The state of the Combat Log and Crew Status UIs will be preserved between missions.
[*] Clarified progress on escort missions terminal activations.
[*] Damage reduction effects will no longer be listed as Barrier reductions in the Combat Log.
[*] Updated Codex to include new Zeroing and Hyperburst stats.
[*] Target dodge is now displayed when inspecting a target.
[*] Fixed issue with gas traps failing to display correctly and draining / filling at odd speeds.
[*] Reduced strength of fisheye effect from gas traps.
[*] Gas traps now display a particle effect to warn of an active gas trap in a room before entering.
[/list]

[h1][b]Misc Fixes[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the mission Rescuing Rassa that could cause an event to deadend.
[*] Fixed an issue with Retrieval missions that could cause a failure to award credits.
[*] Fixed an issue with Ironmode that could cause the game to flip out in various ways if the hero character was killed but the party survived combat.
[*] Fixed CorpSec Seekers (and variants) from triggering their intro sound simultaneously resulting in possible brain explosions.
[*] In the briefing for mission Cage the Gorzilla, fixed an issue wherein Eliana North would ask you to determine the point of entry of the strange drones but the mission objective was to determine their prime directive.
[*] Fixed Ragnarok failing to award rep when completing The Train Job objective for them.
[*] Fixed typo in random event encountering faction employee and added a new distraction.
[*] Fixed an issue with taking control of the security camera in the mission Triangulatin’ that could cause its movement to be locked.
[*] Fixed funky shadows being cast by Astral Worms.
[*] Fixed various typos and text alignments in UI, abilities, events and effects - thanks tinysalamander!
[/list]

[b]Coming Next[/b][list]
[*] Item upgrades!
[*] More friendly faction contact events.
[*] More cool stuff!
[/list]

notes.title: StarCrawlers Patch Notes 7/17 - Cage the Gorzilla
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/iEy1CwJ.gif[/img]
The next story mission has arrived: Cage the Gorzilla! We hope you enjoy it :D Huge thanks to everyone who has been submitting bug reports here on the forums and with the in-game tool - tons of fixes in this update!

[h1][b]Prototype[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect tooltip in combat for Demean ability.
[*] Fixed Time Unit cost display for abilities that have variable amounts.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause Prototype to be available to recruit in subsequent games without first unlocking him in the story.
[/list]

[h1][b]Soldier[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Time Unit cost display for abilities that have variable amounts.
[/list]

[h1][b]Force Psyker[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Spirit Onslaught that could cause the caster’s crit chance to read as 0%.
[/list]

[h1][b]Hacker[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause Kill Switch and Corruption to prevent combat from continuing if they strike the killing blow against a mob.
[/list]

[h1][b]Items[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Accessories that load incorrectly will now attempt to substitute a placeholder item.
[b]> > >[/b] Let us know the ID code and we’ll fix it!
[*] Facility shelves have a chance to spawn medkits, energon cubes, and grenade cases.
[*] Medkits found on the mission The Black Box no longer incorrectly contain random loot.
[*] Hacking security doors and panels will correctly consume AutoCiphers once again.
[*] Titan has their own manufacturer upgrades for crit resistance and is no longer stealing upgrades from Boomslang.
[*] Fixed an issue with medkits from older saves being unusable in missions or combat.
[*] Fixed crit resistance upgrades decreasing crit resistance.
[/list]

[h1][b]Environment[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Walking through liquid hot magma should be approximately 500% more fatal.
[*] Office maps now can have Executive Doors which are superior to lesser doors.
[*] Fixed an issue with radiation traps that could cause them to appear stuck behind desks.
[*] Fixed an issue on the mission Triangulatin’ that could cause events to fail to trigger after defeating a section boss.
[/list]

[h1][b]UI[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause factions to not show when visiting the Wire terminal after a certain plot point triggers.
[*] Creating a new save will now correctly increment the save number before saving.
[*] UI scaling will now be applied consistently after a scene load.
[*] Fixed an issue on the mission Triangulatin’ that could cause a plot point to be skipped.
[*] Removed legacy support for clamping faction reputation for story mission factions (Horizon, Aurora, Workers  United)
[*] Fixed a potential reset of reputation when dealing with Workers United.
[*] Labeled the water pump in To Catch A Privateer / Rescuing Rassa more clearly.
[*] Factions that send hate mail will give up after they hate you enough. How reasonable!
[*] Items that are force-given during events can now arrive via mail if your inventory is full.
[*] Fixed an issue with credit rewards on randomly generated missions not being displayed.
[*] Fixed an issue with name generation that could cause input to become locked.
[/list]

[h1][b]Misc Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with an event in The Train Job that could cause it to repeat incorrectly.
[*] Fixed an issue with Electric Traps that could cause a mission to fail to load.
[*] Fixed an issue with skipping the tutorial that could lead to incorrect progression.
[*] CorpSec Guards will no longer summon reinforcements if there are only 2 crawlers alive.
[*] Fixed mobs scaling armor incorrectly on Standard difficulty.
[*] Fixed an issue with a certain character encountered previously that might cause them to be confused about who they are now. Cryptic!
[*] Added options to continuing exploring after completing The Train Job and using a terminal to exit the mission.
[/list]

[b]Coming Next[/b]
[list]
[*] New Story Mission!
[*] More friendly faction contact events.
[*] More cool stuff!
[/list]

notes.title: StarCrawlers Patch Notes 6/3 - Elemental Madness
notes.notes:
If your older saves load with the team at 0 health, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/318970/discussions/0/350532795324138691/]visit the medbay and get patched up![/url]

[h1][b]Elemental Madness has arrived.[/b][/h1]
An elemental damage system has been bubbling beneath the surface of StarCrawlers for a while and now it’s ready to burst forth in all it’s zapping, burning, melting, devouring and terrifying glory. In addition, we’ve added a Combat Log, new twists to Challenge & Hardcore difficulties, and tons of improvements to class abilities, weapons, armor, shields and accessories. Dig in!

[h1][b]Elemental Damage[/b][/h1]
Class abilities can now deal basic Physical damage, elemental damage (Energy, Fire, Chemical, Nanite or Void). multiple types of elemental damage, or channel the element of your equipped weapon. Most generated weapons will deal Physical damage, but rarer and high-level items can deal elemental damage. Mobs also deal elemental damage with some of their attacks and the power of elemental attacks from mob abilities grows as they level.

[h1][b]Elemental Resistances[/b][/h1]
Elemental damage is absorbed by Barriers and Shields as normal, but pierces Armor. The block power of Armor has been increased to serve as a superior defense against Physical attacks, and the absorption power of Shields has been slightly reduced. When facing elemental damage, you’ll want to stack resistances to reduce the incoming damage to manageable levels. Armor, shields, accessories, item upgrades and class abilities can all contribute to resistances. Similarly, mobs have natural resistances to some elements and have gained abilities to boost resistances.

[h1][b]Classes[/b][/h1]
There have been significant changes to the class trees to incorporate the new elemental damage system. All classes abilities that deal damage now deal either Physical, Energy, Fire, Chemical, Nanite or Void damage. Some classes will see further abilities updates and changes as we test the new system and receive feedback.

[h1][b]Soldier[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Reduced max effectiveness of Meat Shield to 20% damage reduction and increased base damage slightly.
[*] Defiance now reduces damage if the enemy is Taunted to attack the Soldier.
[*] The cooldown on Juggernaut has been increased to 8 turns.
[*] Bouncing Betty no longer drops bomblets at Rank 3 if the Soldier has been killed.
[*] Rocket Strike max damage slightly reduced and no longer pierces Armor as it now deals Fire damage (which bypasses Armor).
[*] Hellfire Salvo damage slightly decreased and now randomly attacks the battlefield instead of random mobs, making it more chaotic, but guaranteeing a hit if a rocket lands near a mob. This make Hellfire Salvo more effective against multiple enemies and less deadly against a single target.
[*] UXO now tosses out extra Bomblets when activated, removing the requirement that Bomblets are already deployed to use it.
[*] Boom King at Rank 3 now also causes targets damaged by your Bomblets to take increased damage from Fire attacks. This effect stacks.
[*] Bonus damage taken by enemies hit with a Heavy Weapon in Overwatch reduced to 5/7/10%.
[*]The max damage of Hotstreak has been reduced to 200% weapon damage and the Time Unit cost reduced to 25% of weapon speed.
[/list]


[h1][b]Force Psyker[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Mirror Prism now deals damage to all enemies when it manifests. Shatter damage dealt to the Force Psyker is converted to Energy damage.
[*] Spirit Armor now provides passive elemental resistance to allies in combat and heals the Force Psyker when taking Energy damage at Rank 3.
[*] Purifying Prism no longer damages the Force Psyker but instead deals damage to enemies when it absorbs a debuff or stun effect or shatters as Rank 3.
[*] Barrier Prison now attempts to Stun the target each turn and deal weapon damage.
[*] Spirit Link now grants resistance to all enemies when a Barrier absorbs elemental damage.
[*] Fists of Fury (Rank 3) now increases Energy damage taken by the target.
[/list]


[h1][b]Void Psyker[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] The damage of Overload has been reduced as it now deals elemental Void damage.
[*] The damage on Cannibalize has been slightly reduced.
[*] The damage of Shadowbolt / Voidbolt has been slightly reduced and the energy requirement to convert to Voidbolt has been reduced to 30.
[*] Torrent (Rank 3) now increases Void damage taken by the target.
[*] Void Storm now strikes randomly across the battlefield and deals increased damage.
[*] Ascendance (Rank 3) now grants Void resistance to your allies if you Overload and makes the Void Psyker immune to damage from Overload.
[/list]


[h1][b]Prototype[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Reduced Time Unit cost of Thunderclap.
[/list]

[h1][b]Engineer[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Junker no longer Taunts but can explode to deal Chemical damage and increase damage taken from Chemical attacks.
[/list]


[h1][b]Hacker[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Virus: Mindmelt no longer stacks damage with each use but instead reduces the Nanite resistance of the target.
[*] The explosion damage of Corruption has been reformulated to grow based on weapon damage.
[*] Virus: Hotlink no longer provides Haste but instead deals damage based on your weapon element and grants team resistance to the same element.
[*] Timed Release no longer regenerates shield but instead increases the duration of Optimization tree effects and grants a chance to refresh them automatically. At Rank 3, team damage grows with each turn the Hacker takes.
[*] Fixed an issue with Scramble that could upset the orderly progression of the timeline.
[*] Fixed an issue with Root Hack that could prevent enemies from acting on their turn.
[/list]

[h1][b]Difficulty[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] On Standard and higher difficulties, leveling up no longer heals to full but instead maintains the current health percentage.
[*] On Challenge Difficulty, characters will not heal automatically at the end of a mission but can skip a mission, visit the medbay, or use a medkit to heal.
[*] On Hardcore Difficulty, characters must visit the medbay or use a medkit to heal.
[*] On Challenge and higher difficulties, killed characters have a chance to incur a Grievous Wound after being revived. The severity of the wound increases with each death.
[*] On Hardcore Difficulty, Grievous Wounds are permanent.
[/list]

[h1][b]Enemies[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Mobs now have base resistances to elemental damage that scales with their level.
[*] Mob special attacks now deal elemental damage that scales with their level..
[/list]

[h1][b]Items[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Armor now only blocks Physical (basic) damage and its effectiveness has been increased for both mobs and players.
[*] Shields and Barriers continue to absorb all types of damage and their effectiveness has been slightly reduced.
[*] Weapons can be generated with a chance to deal elemental damage with their standard attack.
[*] Armor and Shields can be generated with a base resistance to elemental attacks.
[*] Upgrades for Weapons, Armor and Shields can improve elemental damage & resistance.
[*] Siyama has begun producing weapons that deal Energy, Fire and Chemical damage.
[*] Zeus has begun producing weapons that deal Nanite damage.
[*] Foxkin has arrived as a manufacturer of fine weapons, armor and shields.
[*] Weapons now have additional generated names.
[/list]


[h1][b]UI[/b][/h1]
Combat Log added to combat and currently displays:
[list]
[*] All damage absorbed by barriers.
[*] All damage absorbed by shields.
[*] Physical damage blocked by armor.
[*] Health damage taken.
[*] Additional information will be added in future updates and the ability to toggle visibility for different display types.
[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where events in the hub would not lock some menu controls.
[*] Fixed Crew Status close button overlapping enemies and confusing the UI.
[*] Fixed issue that could cause Battle Icons to not display health bars / numbers accurately if there was a large volume of incoming damage.
[*] Fixed an issue with Soldiers Weapon Specialist that could prevent cooldown resetting on kills.
[*] Fixed an issue with the mission Dumpster Diving which could halt combat.
[*] Fixed an issue breaking the contact event for Chimera BioPharma Solutions.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause accessories to not load updated stats.
[/list]

[b]Coming Next[/b]
[list]
[*] Now New Story Mission!
[*] More friendly faction contact events.
[*] More cool stuff!
[/list]

notes.title: StarCrawlers Patch Notes 5/20/2016
notes.notes:
[h1]UPDATED: 5/26/2016 [/h1]Find information on the coming [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/318970/discussions/0/357287304424950555/]Level Cap here![/url]

Ironmode has arrived! As requested, you can now subject yourself to permadeath in StarCrawlers by starting a new game with the Ironmode option selected. Mercenaries can now join your crew for a limited time under special circumstances - the first first mercenary available is the enigmatic Mr. Lieu, a security consultant working for Kage Enterprises. Expect to see more mercenaries become available from Factions in the future!

[h1][b]Ironmode[/b][/h1]
This is the first time this feature has been activated, so if you choose to go Ironmode, we’d love to hear about your experience, be it good or (probably) bad! :D
[list]
[*] New games with difficulty of Standard or higher can choose to activate Ironmode.
[*] Limit of 1 Ironmode save that auto updates.
[*] Character death is [b]permanent[/b] and equipped gear is lost forever.
[*] The Ironmode save updates whenever a character dies.
[*] If all recruited characters are killed the Ironmode save is deleted.
[*] Not for the faint of heart.
[/list]

[h1][b]Mercenaries[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Mercenaries can temporarily join your crew for a mission.
[*] Mr. Lieu, a friendly smuggler, can be hired after reaching Allied reputation with Kage.
[*] Unique mercenaries can be obtained from rare drops.
[/list]

[h1][b]Factions[/b][/h1][list]
[*] Kage Enterprises can now be contacted via the Wire terminal. 
[*] Kage can supply items to help crawlers deal with traps, provided they like you.
[*] Fixed some typos in the Jiyin contact event.

notes.title: StarCrawlers Patch Notes - 4/15/2016
notes.notes:
Latest hotfix notes (now with Experimental Changes) can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/318970/discussions/0/611701360818631847/]here![/url].

The next story mission has arrived: Dumpster Diving!
Your investigations into the rogue drones aboard the [i]Stella Marin[/i] have led you deep within the bowels of the ghost ship. Have you discovered the source of the mystery? Or merely the beginning of some new terror…

[h1][b]PLEASE NOTE![/b][/h1]
If you are still having issues with your keybindings (for example, Free Look, Flashlight, ESC menu), reset your player preferences to clear them from the registry :
From the Title Screen -> Options -> Reset Preferences.
[b]Resetting your keybindings alone will not resolve these issues.[/b]

[h1][b]Shields[/b][/h1]
Based on feedback and discussion, we’re trying something different with shields to make them more intuitive for both choosing which to equip and understanding enemy shield strength at a glance. Previously, light shields had many charges and heavy shields had fewer, and the range of damage absorbed by shield types was quite large. Now:
[list]
[*] The amount of damage absorbed by shields has been normalized and ranges reduced.
[*] Light shields have 3 charges and the ability to Regenerate during combat.
[*] Tactical shields have 3 to 5 charges and Empower the wearer when a charge is used.
[*] Heavy shields have 5 to 8 charges and maintain their Safeguard ability.
[/list]
We feel these changes make shields more intuitive at a glance, for both team and mob gear. Fewer charges = less shields and dmg reduction, more charges = more shields and dmg reduction. Let us know what you think about this change!

[h1][b]Weapons[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Melee weapons have been reduced in damage to bring them more in-line with ranged weapons of similar TU cost.
[/list]

[h1][b]Classes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Hacker’s Mindmelt now properly displays duration and stack damage when refreshed.
[*] Duration of Prototype’s Demean taunt effect extended.
[*] Smuggler’s Shoot First now applies at the start of combat, not on the Smuggler’s first turn.
[*] Smuggler’s Kalmonri Trap no longer sometimes believes itself to be a mob.
[/list]

[h1][b]Game Difficulty[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Challenge scales Boss Fights to your level and traps deal bonus damage.
[*] Hardcore scales missions and Bosses to your level and traps deal deadly damage.
[/list]

[h1][b]UI[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated Codex to reflect changes to shield type bonuses.
[*] Your initial character choice is now remembered by the game as the Hero Character. For legacy saves, this will be set automatically upon saving to the character you first chose.
[/list]

[h1][b]Environment[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Security Doors can no longer be opened by mobs on the other side.
[*] Nanite Swarms will now disperse after inflicting a set amount of damage to your party.
[*] Don’t trip the traps and there won’t be no Nanite Swarms.
[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] The value of the Shionlium Lunchbox has been increased to match credits rewarded when skipping the tutorial mission.
[*] Fixed unintentionally displaying mob info when clicking an item in combat inventory.
[*] Fixed healthbar display for characters in combat inventory selection.
[*] Fixed an issue with random map generation that could prevent mission progress.
[*] Fixed an issue that would cause the healthbar on battle icons appear to drain at the start of combat, giving the illusion of taking damage.
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon…[/b]
[list]
[*] Focus On: New Story Mission...
[*] More friendly faction contact events.
[*] More cool stuff!
[/list]

[*] Fixed various typos in random events.
[*] Fixed an issue with Cyberninja’s Rolling Thunder that could cause damage to go negative when combined with other class events.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause Retrieve missions to appear as failed when beginning.
[*] Fixed clipping issue on Saloon door in space station.
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause mob Defense Boost effects to be hidden.

[/list]

[b]Coming Soon…[/b]

[*] More cool stuff!

notes.title: StarCrawlers Patch Notes 3/18
notes.notes:
This week focuses on bug fixes and prepping for the next story mission patch. In addition, we’ve patched in some enemies and missions that aren’t quite ready to be revealed :D We’ve introduced an Opt In button on the title screen - if you’re interested in testing out some spoiler-heavy and potentially unstable content, check it out!

[h1][b]PLEASE NOTE![/b][/h1]
If you are still having issues with your keybindings (for example, Free Look, Flashlight, ESC menu), reset your player preferences to clear them from the registry :
From the Title Screen -> Options -> Reset Preferences.
[b]Resetting your keybindings alone will not resolve these issues.[/b]

[h1][b]Known Issues[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] The hardware cursor is displayed instead of the StarCrawlers cursor when mousing over certain UI elements / interactives.
[/list]

[h1][b]Factions[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Jiyin Biotech can now be contacted via the Wire Terminal.
[*] Chimera allies can now access their max tier reward from Junior Researcher Smoth.
[/list]

[h1][b]Items[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] New armor enhancements, utility item, and accessory that can only be acquired from Jiyin.
[*] Healing amount for medkits have been reduced.
[/list]

[h1][b]Classes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Self-healing for most classes has been reduced slightly. We’re monitoring self-healing moving forward to drive it more towards sustaining a character vs. healing to full with each battle. 
[/list]


[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with hotkeys not responding after using Continue from title screen after a wipe.
[*] Fixed issue with menus not responding after attempting to ESC / open a menu during an event in the space station.
[*] Fixed issue with Void Psyker Siphon Life rank 3 bonus not being applied correctly.
[*] Unity Engine: Linux users should now be able to set resolutions that differ from their naitive resolution (ie. two monitor set up)
[*] Miscellaneous optimizations and tweaks for all platforms.
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon…[/b]
[list]
[*] Focus On: New Story Mission - Triangulatin’

[*] More cool stuff!

notes.title: StarCrawlers Patch Notes 3/5 - Factions (Part II)
notes.notes:
This week is all about Factions that dislike you! All Factions can now take action against you if they feel the situation merits it and the conditions are right. The more a faction dislikes you, the more they’ll be willing to spend to have you killed. There are multiple different actions they might pursue, ranging from briefing their employees about you and upping CorpSec patrols to hiring mercenaries and assassins. In addition, Chimera and Titan can now be contacted via the Wire Terminal.

[h1][b]PLEASE NOTE![/b][/h1]
If you are still having issues with your keybindings (for example, Free Look, Flashlight, ESC menu), reset your player preferences to clear them from the registry :
From the Title Screen -> Options -> Reset Preferences.
[b]Resetting your keybindings alone will not resolve these issues.[/b]

[h1][b]Factions[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Allegiances have shifted among the UFP and hidden organizations.
[*] Chimera BioPharma Solutions can now be contacted via the Wire Terminal.
[*] Titan Metallurgy can now be contacted via the Wire Terminal.
[*] Factions can now trigger operations against your team when you’ve sufficiently angered them and the conditions are right…
[*] Some consumable can now modify your favor with Factions…
[*] Added new mob types that are only encountered through Faction operations.
[*] Added new syndromes only obtainable through positive and negative faction events.
[*] Added FoxKin Armory faction.
[/list]

[h1][b]Items[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Using the Take All button on mail will attempt to loot all items and then delete the mail.
[*] Using the Delete button on mail with items will attempt to collect the items first.
[*] Added new armor, enhancements, utility items and more that can only be acquired from Factions. Happy hunting!
[/list]

[h1][b]UI[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added an error reporting tool and force quit for events. You can now submit bug reports for events just like map / regular bugs and force broken events to end immediately.
[/list]


[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug with Free Look upon exiting combat.
[*] Fixed Audio Panel not closing when hitting ESC key.
[*] Equipable items that apply syndromes (such as Eternal Dumpling Basket) will no longer lose their applied syndrome if their owner gains a level on a mission.
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon…[/b]
[list]
[*] Focus On: Factions (Part III)!
[*] More friendly faction contact events.
[*] More negative faction operations.
[*] Class Accessories
[*] More cool stuff!
[/list]

notes.title: StarCrawlers Patch Notes 2/5 - Happy Lunar New Year!
notes.notes:
In prep for features in the upcoming Factions update, we’re testing out the new systems with a small Lunar New Year event. When visiting the space station, look for Rassa the Hook, a special item vendor. Rassa and his crew have been hiding Lucky Envelopes in various places, grab an envelope and you’ll find a Lunar Coin which can be traded for various festive items.

[h1][b]Focus on: Lab Maps, Item Enhancements and More![/b][/h1]
Lab maps have been enhanced and improved based on feedback and suggestions and we’re excited to show a new item type: Enhancements! We’ve heard your requests for more ways to customize and tweak gear beyond the upgrade system, so Enhancements can permanently alter a weapon, armor, shield or accessory once to change its stats or add new effects.

[h1][b]Linux Update[/b][/h1]
We've temporarily disabled the Linux build as we investigate the crashing shader issue - latest updates can be found [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/318970/discussions/0/487877107142234366/]here[/url].

[h1][b]UI[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed several alignment issues.
[*] Added support for special currencies in addition to credits. Special currencies are not currently displayed outside of the merchant menu that uses them.
[*] Switched on 5:4 Aspect Ratio - please note this ratio has not been fully tested for all menus.
[*] When loading a game, the most recent Autosave is highlighted and placed at the top of the load menu and saves are correctly ordered according to timestamp. - thanks Jaesun!
[/list]

[h1][b]Items[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Add Common and Uncommon item Enhancements for weapons, armor and shields.
[*] Added new items for Lunar New Year celebration.
[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash when a Void Psyker with an active Void Shell triggered an Overload.
[*] Fixed an issue where loot containers in bug infestation missions would sometimes be empty. - thanks Allanpike!
[*] Fixed an issue where adjusting the ambient gamma would create an additive brightness effect with each battle. - thanks ZiN!
[*] Fixed an issue with A.N.C.Hs failing to activate or activating for summoned pets.
[*] Fixed an issue with item icon duplication on some menus.
[*] Fixes class combat widgets emitting particles when offscreen & depth sorting issues.
[*] Fixed Talent Point Notification button from appearing during events on missions.
[*] Fixed an issue with shield pip display count on the Loadout menu.
[*] Fixed an issue with Hatches on Ships handing out items when they weren’t meant to.
[*] Free look rotations can no longer become gimbal locked when looking past angles that are straight up / straight down. As a result, you can look upside down, should you so wish. Enabling ‘Reset Camera on Move’ or tapping spacebar will reset rotations, as usual.
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon…[/b]
[list]
[*] Focus On: Factions!
[*] Contact factions you have discovered and have friendly chats with them over the Wire.
[*] Request unique items from factions that like you.
[*] Request amnesty from factions that are trying to kill you.
[*] Lexicon - defines game teminology & mechanics for the Learned Crawler. Almost complete!
[*] More Events, Hot Loot items and Mini Events
[*] More cool stuff!
[/list]

notes.title: StarCrawlers Patch Notes 1/25 - Facilities and More!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Focus on: Facility Maps, Class Accessories and Combat Consumables[/b][/h1]
Facility maps have been enhanced and improved based on feedback and suggestions and we’re trying out a new type of event with neutral Loader drones hanging out on some facility maps. The Loaders are tied to many of the operations in a facility and may be willing to help on your mission, and possibly provide other benefits… Have a chat with them and let us know what you think!
We’re also debuting Class Accessories and Combat Consumables - details below.

[h1][b]UI[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Based on user requests, we’ve added an item stash to Doc Sams’ bar.
[*] Ambient light gamma adjust added to Graphics menu.
[/list]

[h1][b]Items[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Combat consumable items have arrived. Keep an eye out for Boomslang’s newest line of grenades and some secret items - more coming in next patch.
[*] Class Accessories have arrived. Rare components can drop on all map types, gather them and the appropriate blueprint and find an AutoCraft Bench to assemble the item. We’ll be expanding and adding to Class Accessories with each patch. Let us know if you get one!
[*] Added Class Accessory for Void Psyker.
[*] Added Class Accessory for Engineer.
[/list]

[h1][b]Exploration[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Optimized pathing in Facility maps to reduce or eliminate overlapping vertical floor tiles.
[*] New secret, interactive and decorative elements in Facility maps.
[/list]

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
[*] Reduced Accuracy debuff from MomoBomb from 30% to 15%.
[*] Cyberninja’s Kougeki ability now deals 60/80/100% weapon damage for each Combo Point.
[*] Cyberninja’s Flurry ability now deals 80/90/100% weapon damage for each Combo Point.
[*] Cyberninja’s Expose Weakness initial attack now deals 60/80/100% weapon damage.
[*] In preparation for the Factions update, extraneous factions have been disabled to focus on story and gameplay critical factions.
[*] Boomslang has a negotiated a seat at the table with the Universal Foundation for Prosperity and has become the official arms supplier for the UFP and its client companies.
[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Adjust all materials & lighting to accommodate new specular lighting algorithm. 
[*] That was a lot.
[*] Fixed an issue with bounty targets that shouted their name not shouting it.
[*] Fixed an issue with Force Psyker’s Barrier Prison particle effect when breaking.
[*] Fixed an issue with Force Psyker’s Condemn particle effect when breaking.
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon…[/b]
[list]
[*] Focus On: Lab Maps
[*] Lexicon - defines game teminology & mechanics for the Learned Crawler. Almost ready :D
[*] New Lab Mobs + Rare Spawns
[*] More Events, Hot Loot items and Mini Events
[*] More cool stuff!
[/list]

notes.title: StarCrawlers Patch Notes - 1/8/2016 - Space Pirates!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Focus on: The Ships & Space Pirates[/b][/h1]
Happy New Year! Ship maps have been enhanced and improved based on feedback and suggestions. On Ship maps you’ll encounter new enemies, events, hazards, and a variety of ways to get your crew killed. Space Pirates have banded together to form The Scarlet Pact faction and have started appearing as mission targets.

[h1][b]Missions[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new mission customizations to all types to include the new Pirate faction.
[*] Pirate Captains can now be bounty hunt targets.
[*] CorpSec Officers that are bounty hunt targets have picked up new tricks.
[*] Missions that do not target another faction directly have had their rep reward reduced.
[*] Mission difficulty now has a larger impact on the number and lethality of traps.
[/list]

[h1][b]Combat[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new Pirate enemy types to Ship, Corporate, Lab, Facility and Mine maps.
[*] Added new unique Pirate combat loot drops.
[*] Consumables (chems, medkits, etc) can now be used in combat with an improved interface.
[*] Added additional sounds for Cyberninja and Force Psyker abilities.
[/list]

[h1][b]Exploration[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Enemies that are intelligent enough and authorized can now open doors to pursue you.
[*] Ship maps now feature a unique event that allows skilled teams to access different systems of the ship to reveal objectives, enemies, disable traps, and more.
[*] New event types added for Ships.
[*] New hot loot items for Ships.
[/list]

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
[*] The Ability Point maximum now caps at 63. Characters with excess points can adjust theirs by visiting the Medbay and resetting your Ability Points.
[*] Based on user feedback, when running missions with less than 3 crawlers, enemy numbers in combat are reduced. Does not affect boss fights or enemy strength. We’d like to hear your feedback on how this mechanic feels!
[*] Easy and Cakewalk missions no longer spawn fewer encounters due to difficulty, but the individual strength of mobs in combat is still reduced.
[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where using Autosave & Quit from the spacestation ESC menu could fail to update the autosave correctly - thanks samuraipoet!
[*] Fixed an issue where saving with 1 crawler could cause an issue in the saloon - thanks Lyric!
[*] Player tabs in explore mode now correctly reflect the current health of the team.
[*] Fixed an issue where context text boxes could persist into combat.
[*] Fixed an issue with secret rooms inside some Corp rooms leading into spaaaaace!
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon…[/b]
[list]
[*] Focus On: Facility Maps
[*] Lexicon - defines game teminology & mechanics for the Learned Crawler.
[*] New Facility Mobs + Rare Spawns
[*] More Events, Hot Loot items and Mini Events
[*] More cool stuff!
[/list]

[*] Pirate Captains can now be bounty hunt targets.
[*] CorpSec Officers that are bounty hunt targets have picked up new tricks.
[*] Missions that do not target another faction directly have had their rep reward reduced.
[*] Mission difficulty now has a larger impact on the number and lethality of traps.
[/list]

[h1][b]Combat[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new Pirate enemy types to Ship, Corporate, Lab, Facility and Mine maps.
[*] Added new unique Pirate combat loot drops.

[*] Added additional sounds for Cyberninja and Force Psyker abilities.

[h1][b]Exploration[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Enemies that are intelligent enough and authorized can now open doors to pursue you.
[*] Ship maps now feature a unique event that allows skilled teams to access different systems of the ship to reveal objectives, enemies, disable traps, and more.

[*] Player tabs in explore mode now correctly reflect the current health of the team.
[*] Fixed an issue where context text boxes could persist into combat.
[*] Fixed an issue with secret rooms inside some Corp rooms leading into spaaaaace!

[list]
[*] Focus On: Facility Maps
[*] Lexicon - defines game teminology & mechanics for the Learned Crawler.
[*] New Facility Mobs + Rare Spawns
[*] More Events, Hot Loot items and Mini Events
[*] More cool stuff!
[/list]

notes.title: StarCrawlers Patch Notes - 12/4/2015
notes.notes:
Happy Friday! We've uploaded a bug fix patch based on issues reported by players that also includes new controls to adjust different graphics settings, improvements to escort missions, and a few more items. Have a great weekend!

[h1][b]UI[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] The Graphics menu now provides additional options to optimize various settings.
[*] Enable UI Scaling added to graphics menu. Toggling this on will allow the UI to scale up or down to the resolution you are playing at. Recommended for Big Picture players!
[*] Crawlers now have access to a flashlight using the F hotkey.
[*] The UI should now scale better for extremely high-res monitors / Steam Big Picture play.
[*] Improved objective & exit text for Escort, Objective, Retrieve mission types.
[*] Discovered objective markers now remain visible on the map until completed.
[/list]

[h1][b]Audio[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Additional sounds have been added for Void Psyker, Soldier and Hacker abilities.
[/list]

[h1][b]Missions[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] It is no longer possible to reroll random missions by save / loading.
[*] Quest items no longer have crazy credit values.
[*] Intentionally failing and selling quest items is no longer possible.
[*] Escort NPCs have improved abilities and are now considered part of your team temporarily. They can be inspected in the loadout screen, given chems and medkits, and will take damage from traps. They’ve also finally figured out how to make use of their weapons to help out in fights. And get themselves killed.
[/list]

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] In preparation for upcoming changes to the faction system, Aurora and Horizon no longer offer missions or can be the target of missions.
[*] New Crawlers start with 100 credits. Spend ‘em wisely.
[*] The price of recruiting new Crawlers no longer scales with the number you have already recruited but is instead 100 credits + 50 per level of the recruit.
[*] The cost to revive a mostly-dead Crawler is now 10% of your total credits. If you can’t afford the minimum fee, Lukas Filch will provide the service free of charge...
[/list]

[h1][b]Class Changes[/b][/h1]
Force Psykers and Void Psykers are dealing impressive but slightly too much damage in comparison to other classes. We’ll be making further adjustments to all classes abilities over time.
[list]
[*] Force Psykers no longer start every battle with full energy but instead regenerate 5 Force Energy with every step outside of combat. In-combat regen remains unchanged. 
[*] Damage of Force Psyker’s Aegis Strike reduced to 50/75/100% weapon damage and damage increased per bounce reduced to 5/7/10%.
[*] Damage of Void Psyker’s Shadowcoil reduced to 20/25/30% weapon damage per attack.
[*] The damage bonus from the passive ability Ascendance for having Void Energy over 100 is now applied correctly and at the end of the Void Pskyer’s turn.
[*] Cosmic Horror no longer applies a damage amplification effect to victims but instead summons additional tentacles.
[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where an unlocked Prototype could wander into a new game.
[*] Fixed an issue with Autosave not appearing in the Load Game menu.
[*] Fixed an issue with Smuggler’s Fan the Hammers effect not being displayed as a buff.
[*] Fixed an issue with mouse Y invert not being applied correctly if changed while on a mission.
[*] Fixed an issue with laser tripbeams not being clickable in some security side-rooms
[*] Fixed issues with secret rooms sometimes making nearby floor tiles inaccessible
[*] Black Ice is now properly described as a Hacker construct
[*] Reporting a blackmail attempt with a Smuggler no longer causes an error if the attempt fails
[*] Fixed an issue where Mites and some Worm variants received double their intended bonus for damage. Little critters were biting pretty hard.
[*] Fixed an issue with the camera effect for gas traps sometimes persisting after leaving the gas trap room while gas was still draining.
[*] Gas traps can no longer lock the room they are triggered in.
[*] Fixed several instances of black / white walls appearing erroneously. This bug should no longer occur on any map - thanks to everyone who sent it screenshots of this one!
[/list]

notes.title: StarCrawlers Beta 6 - Felonious Fox - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1][b]StarCrawlers Beta 6 - Felonious Fox[/b][/h1]
IIn addition to Unity 5, we’ve added a ton of new content and systems. A huge THANK YOU to everyone supporting us with feedback and bug reports - we've got a big build for you in return. Dig in!

[h1][b]Unity 5[/b][/h1]
Upgrading StarCrawlers to use Unity 5 allows a big increase in the visual quality we are able to achieve with full 64bit (and still 32bit) compatibility. The most immediate improvements will be noticeable in the Corporate environments (the focus for this update) and will expand to the other environments as we continue to update. Please note that being able to adjust specific attributes of graphics settings is not implemented yet - StarCrawlers at launch will support a variety of system specs and the ability to adjust and reduce the more memory intensive visuals will be provided.

[h1][b]Focus On: The Mobs & Corp Environments & Much More![/b][/h1]
Mob health, damage, and player weapon damage has been rescaled. The new system allows for more gradual increments between levels. In general, mobs will have less health but hit harder. Additionally, the following mobs have acquired new abilities and will change their abilities and tactics as your team levels :
[list]
[*] CorpSec Drone Mk. I
[*] CorpSec Hoplite
[*] CorpSec Imperator
[*] CorpSec Observer
[*] CorpSec Guard
[/list]

[h1][b]Armor and Shields[/b][/h1]
Decay is dead! After a lot of experimentation and discussion with the community, we’re reverting the Shields and Armor system to the previous mechanic of blocking flat amounts of damage. With that in effect, there is no more need for the decay mechanic. Woot!

[h1][b]Items[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Level requirements have been removed for all items. 
[*] Weapons now have additional modifiers unique to different weapon types:
	[*] Pistol : Combat Initiative increased.
	[*] SMG : Aggression grants bonus damage on first round of combat.
	[*] Rifle : Shield Breaker destroys bonus Shields when dealing damage.
	[*] Shotgun : Bonus critical hit damage.
	[*] Heavy : Armor Pierce ignores a % of target Armor damage reduction.
	[*] Melee : Shield Pierce ignores a % of target Shield damage reduction.

[*] Armors now have additional modifiers unique to different armor types:
	[*] Light: All damage dealt increased.
	[*] Tactical: Maneuver immediately reduces current Time Units on Dodge success.
	[*] Heavy: Resistance to critical hits increased.

[*] Shields now have additional modifiers unique to different shield types:
	[*] Light: Charges regenerate when enough Time Units have passed for the owner.
	[*] Tactical: Maneuver immediately reduces current Time Units on Dodge success.
	[*] Heavy: Resistance to critical hits increased.

[*] Weapons, Armor and Shields using the old damage system will automatically rescale to match similar stats for items using the new damage system. They will also gain type specific bonuses.

[*] Credsticks looted by Smuggler’s Mug ability now automatically convert into credits when looted.
[/list]

[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] STIX has received additional visual polish. We hope you like it :D
[*] The Black Market is open for business. Draal has ‘acquired’ a shipment of Mystery Crates and will sell them to Crawlers (no questions asked). Additional Black Market services will be added in future updates.
[*] Syndromes have arrived. Syndromes are special status effects that persist either permanently for until the end of the next mission. Events, enemies, items and various other things can apply syndromes to your crew.
[*] Junk items are now Loot items and serve as the primary way to gain credits at low levels.
[*] Loot that is dropped in combat but not collected will create a Loot Cache on the ground nearby.
[*] Some environments have high-value Loot items that are owned by the map’s faction. Stealing them will net you a valuable Loot item and negatively affect your rep with the target faction.
[*] Vendors now have an Auto Sell Loot button. Any Loot items that can be sold, will be. Note this will only sell items that have no use other than to sell for credits.
[*] Click-To-Move option added to Controls menu. Enabling will allow either single clicks or holding down the RMB to move forward when exploring. It’s back!
[/list]

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Force Psyker’s Spirit Armor ability has been redesigned. It now provides a boost to Threat and creates a Barrier on your weakest ally for a % of your Armor block value.
[*] Many menus in STIX and on missions have received visual polish and function improvements.
[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Escort jobs not acknowledging you had reached the exit with an NPC.
[*] Escort NPCs now correctly scale their health to the level of the job.
[*] Fixed an issue where starting a new game after loading could confuse new recruits.
[*] Fixed an issue with Quit / Quit to Title when on a Story Mission erroneously failing the mission.
[*] Fixed an issue causing Smuggler’s Holotrap to never activate after certain events.
[*] Fixed an issue where Smuggler’s Shoot First could prevent Fan the Hammers activating.
[*] Fixed an issue where Soldier’s Juggernaut could cause indiscriminate attacks on the team...
[*] Fixed an issue with Cyberninja’s Dash applying Rank 3 Dodge from Stealth incorrectly.
[*] Fixed an issue where Doc Sam would sometimes wander into Mine test events.
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon…[/b]
[list]
[*] Lexicon of game terminology
[*] Focus on: The Mines
[*] New Mines Mobs + Rare Spawns
[*] More Events, Hot Loot items and Mini Events
[*] Next Campaign Mission: Triangulatin.
[*] More cool stuff!
[/list]

notes.title: Unity 5 MiniUpdate Part II
notes.notes:
Cutting down the issues! We're now largely dealing with shader and material glitches that have cropped up in switching to Unity 5, many of which are not immediately apparent until running a mission and encountering this...

[img=http://i.imgur.com/5pEGlg3.jpg][/img]

So we're fixing these as we find them. Another issue is how 5 handles materials and lighting, so all of our maps and rooms will need to be relit. Fortunately this is largely just time consuming and gives great results.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/LgLNuVT.jpg][/img]

Also... Rare Spawns are in! Each mission will have a chance to spawn a rare mob, with increased chance on difficult game / mission settings. Rares drop improved loot, have unique abilities, and are tougher than average mobs. They're also randomly generated. Here's a Chrome Watchdog with two regular Mark I drones.

[img=http://i.imgur.com/z8jtleD.jpg][/img]

Our goal is to have everything in place to test very soon and we'll be putting out the update once we're sure everything is stable. In the meantime - work continues!

notes.title: Unity 5 Update Inbound!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Updating to Unity 5[/b][/h1]

During test builds of the next update we started to encounter issues with Unity 4.6’s ability to compile the project (there’s a lot in there, and Unity 4.6 can only address 3 gigs of memory to build - then it crashes). One solution would be to reduce the quality of or remove assets to allow the project to compile, and while that worked early on, it’s become increasingly problematic and undesirable - we want to add MORE! 

Originally the benefits of moving to Unity 5 were outweighed by the benefits of sticking with 4.6, but that has now reached the tipping point:
[list]
[*] Unity 5 supports offers Auto API update (switches a lot of code from 4.6 to 5 automatically)
[*] Unity 5 can address as much memory as it needs to build, ending the build issue for us.
[*] Unity 5 offers features that will improve how StarCrawlers plays, looks and feels.
[*] Unity is ending support for 4.6.
[/list]
The biggest hurdle with switching to Unity 5 was supposed to be converting our entire codebase (StarCrawlers currently has over 223,500 lines of code) but I’m extremely happy to announce that part is [b]DONE[/b] - we were able to update and fix the entirety of the code in less than a day!

There are some minor animation, graphic, UI, and general transition wonkiness that needs to be resolved, but given how quickly the code was addressed, we’re optimistic about committing to the full transition to Unity 5.

[h1][b]What this means :[/b][/h1] A brief delay before the next update while we complete the transition to Unity 5 and ensure the game is smooth and stable on all platforms- then we’ll be back with even more to show. In the meantime, these guys are on their way…

[img=http://i.imgur.com/ujiLC1j.gif]

[h1][b]Here’s the TLDR version:[/b][/h1] We’re moving to Unity 5! There will be a brief delay while we update the project, but it means more good stuff for the future.

Thank you everyone for your support!!!

notes.title: Upcoming Content Preview
notes.notes:
Our next big update is targeted for Oct. 16th!
As promised, here's a preview of what's coming in the next patch...

[img]http://i.imgur.com/79oPMCf.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Focus On: The Mobs & Much More![/b][/h1]
Mob health, damage, and player weapon damage has been rescaled. The new system allows for more gradual increments between levels. Additionally, the following mobs have acquired new abilities and will change their abilities and tactics as your team levels :
[list]
[*] CorpSec Drone Mk. I
[*] CorpSec Hoplite
[*] CorpSec Imperator
[*] CorpSec Observer
[*] CorpSec Rare Spawns
[/list]

[h1][b]Armor and Shields[/b][/h1]
Decay is dead! After a lot of experimentation and discussion with the community, we’re reverting the Shields and Armor system to the previous mechanic of blocking flat amounts of damage. With that in effect, there is no more need for the decay mechanic.

[h1][b]Items[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Level requirement has been removed for all items. 
[*] Weapons, Armor and Shields using the old damage system will automatically rescale to match similar stats for items using the new damage system. They will also gain new type specific bonuses...
[/list]

[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] STIX has received additional visual polish. We hope you like it :D
[*] The Black Market is open for business. Draal has ‘acquired’ a shipment of Mystery Crates and will sell them to Crawlers (no questions asked). Additional Black Market services will be added in future updates.
[*] Chems are now available to enhance your abilities. Please use responsibly.
[*] Consumable items can be purchased and found.
[*] Syndromes have arrived. Syndromes are special status effects that persist either permanently for until the end of the next mission. Events, enemies, items and various other things can apply syndromes to your crew.
[*] Junk items are now Loot items and  the primary way to gain credits at low levels.
[*] Some environments have high-value Loot items that are owned by the map’s faction. Stealing them will net you a valuable Loot item and negatively affect your rep with the target faction.
[*] Vendors now have an Auto Sell Loot button. Any Loot items that can be sold, will be. Note this will only sell items that have no use other than to sell for credits.
[*] Click-To-Move option added to Controls menu. Enabling will allow either single clicks or holding down the LMB to move forward when exploring. It’s back!
[/list]


[h1][b]Corp Environment Makeover[/b][/h1]
We've identified the Corp office environments as the most pressing need for environment improvement - expect to see big changes to the amount of events, items, secrets, and trouble you can get into in Corp maps.
[list]
[*] Corp map events and interactive items
[*] Secret rooms and caches
[*] Corp specific loot and enemies
[*] Reputation based events
[*] More stuff to steal
[*] Navigation & objective improvements
[/list]
The Corp maps will be a jumping off point for spreading some love to the other environments - we're listening to your feedback :D

[h1][b]And more![/b][/h1]
There are some more exciting additions coming in the next patch... 
Watch for the update Oct. 16th and thanks for playing!

notes.title: Patch Notes for 9/15/2015
notes.notes:
All class abilities are in! That's 8 character classes, 21 abilities per class, 168 abilities total. 
That's a lot of abilities :O

[h1][b]Focus On: The Void Psyker![/b][/h1]

MADNESS! The Void Psyker ability trees have been modified and completed based on feedback and suggestions. Thanks everyone who has been submitting feedback and bug reports - this is the final class to receive all of their abilities! As always, please let us know what you think.

[h1][b]IMPORTANT NOTE FOR MAC USERS![/b][/h1]
If you are playing on a Mac and using OSX Yosemite, you must allow Steam to use Accessibility in order for saves to be written / loaded correctly. Preferences -> Security & Privacy -> Accessibility. Check the box next to Steam. Steam will also prompt you about this when launching.

[h1][b]Void Psyker Class Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Void Energy now decays at a much slower rate outside of combat.
[*] Void Energy can no longer cause an instantly fatal Overload to the Void Psyker.
[*] Void Energy no longer passively provides a damage bonus for stored energy. Use it!
[*] Overload chance reduced and damage from Overload is now a % of average weapon damage modified by the amount of Void Energy when the Overload occurs.
[*] Void Energy now caps at 100 (unless abilities push it higher)
[/list]

[h1][b]Manipulator[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Drain - deals damage and generates Void Energy (although less) if the target has no Shield.
[*] Psi Weapon - reworked to provide crit and bonus damage to your next Strike or Shoot.
[*] Void Shell - now deals a % of weapon damage instead of reflecting damage at max rank.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Whispers - seize control of a target with success based on Void Energy.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Siphon Life - drain hitpoints and Void Energy over a long duration.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Cannibalize - consume buffs from your enemies and deal damage.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Dark Majesty - cause your next Manipulator ability to affect all targets.
[/list]

[h1][b]Evoker[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Shadowbolt / Voidbolt - grows in power and energy gen as you build Void Energy.
Pierces Shields and Armor in both forms.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Ignite - moved from Manipulation and now consumes Void Energy to lay waste to enemy Shields. Also purple fire.
[*] Chaotic Gathering - Reduced healing at max rank and now grants a bonus % of Void Energy in addition to boosting damage based on energy gained.
[*] Removed Burst.
[*] Torrent - now consumes a set amount of Void Energy while creating bonus attacks based on your stored energy. Damage increased.
[*] NEW OLD ABILITY - Voidstorm - It’s back! Consume all of your Void Energy to melt faces.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Backlash - link with an enemy and redirect any Overload damage to them...
[*] NEW ABILITY : Ascendance - increase your maximum Void Energy and gain damage.
[/list]

[h1][b]Summoner[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Shadowcoil - now attacks a set amount of times for each enemy target + visual polish.
[*] Horror - Void Energy cost reduced + visual polish.
[*] Misery - Damage increased and generates bonus Void Energy.
[*] Miasma - Damage no longer decays each turn. Now pierces Shields and Armor.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Rifts - Gaining Void Energy attracts the attention of Nasty Things...
[*] NEW ABILITY : Cthulic Invocation - Summon a lesser monstrosity to harass a target.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Cosmic Horror - Do not use this ability.
[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with audio distortion when using certain Realtek audio drivers. 
[*] Fixed an issue with Cyberninia’s Kougeki adding incorrect CP with Heavy Weapons.
[*] Fixed an issue with Force Psyker’s Spirit Armor sometimes displaying incorrect armor block.
[*] Fixed an issue with Hacker’s Memory Leak dealing incorrect damage.
[*] Fixed an issue where enemies may sometimes choose to ignore Engineer’s Junker taunt.
[*] Fixed an issue with Soldier’s Magnetronc Bomb dealing incorrect damage.
[*] Fixed an issue with Engineer's Charger not calculating Shields correctly.
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon…[/b]
[list]
[*] Focus on: The Mobs (Balance HP vs. DMG + Abilities)
[*] Next Campaign Mission: Triangulatin. (It’s really a'comin!)
[*] More cool stuff!
[/list]

[h1][b]9/17 Hotfix Notes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Cthulic Invocation using an incorrect version of the ability.
[*] Fixed Shadowcoil cooldown and not removing Shield when used on a single target.
[*] Fixed upgrade of items removing an incorrect amount of credits.
[*] Added something really cool for mobs (which isn't active yet :D)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 9/7/2015
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Focus On: The Force Psyker![/b][/h1]

MIND BULLETS! The Force Psyker ability trees have been modified and completed based on feedback and suggestions. Thanks everyone who has been submitting feedback and bug reports - as always, please let us know what you think!

[h1][b]Force Psyker Class Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Force Energy now regenerates each turn at a rate of 25% of your current energy. The more you have, the faster it will regenerate. If the Force Psyker continually uses their strongest abilities, they will deal a lot of damage but quickly become Mentally Exhausted. Alternating powerful attacks with default / weaker attacks allows sustained damage. We’ll continue to refine Force Energy use and regen as we move into balancing abilities!
[*] Removed weapon synergies for Berserker abilities. Abilities that had different effects based on equipped weapon type now have those effects baked into the ability.
[*] Barrier display reworked and now shows health remaining for each barrier in play.
[/list]


[h1][b]Guardian[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Aegis Strike - no longer deals increased Threat or consumes Force Energy with each bounce. Damage now increases with each bounce, damage overall increased.
[*] Mirror Prism - reduced FE cost and increased duration of damage effect and prism health.
[*] Spirit Armor - now provides increased Threat and damage dealing.
[*] Removed Absolution.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Condemn - reduce damage an enemy deals by a large amount.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Inner Peace - heal and regen Force Energy when your Force Energy is low.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Purifying Prism - absorb negative status effects off allies.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Manifest Spirit - manifest a damage dealer also wards allies from death.
[/list]

[h1][b]Sentinel[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Warding Blow - damage boosted and Barrier health from damage reduced to compensate.
[*] Empathic Strike - gains more damage from Barrier absorbed damage.
[*] Warden’s Wrath - no longer consumes Barriers to deal damage but gains damage each time a Barrier is created.
[*] Spirit Link - redesigned to grant Barriers to unprotected allies and reinforce existing Barriers when one is damaged.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Inner Balance - Deal increased damage when Force Energy is high, take less damage when Force Energy is low. Emergency Barrier creation for weak allies.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Barrier Prison : Encase an enemy in a Barrier to prevent them from acting.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Manifest Destiny - Instantly create a Barrier on each ally. Passively increases the health of all Barriers you create.
[/list]

[h1][b]Berserker[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Force Hammer - reduced Force Energy to use and now obliterates shields on critical hits.
[*] Fists of Fury - now retains charges gained each turn, resetting at the end of battle. Force Energy regen at all ranks and visual improved.
[*] Spirit Onslaught - no longer interacts with Daze effects, but increases damage if Stunned.
[*] Mind Bullets - reduced primary target damage and increased secondary target damage.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Inner Turmoil - gain damage and Force Energy regen when low.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Shattering Blow - smash a target to reduce their Armor.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Manifest Rage - manifest a construct to absorb a copy of damage you deal and then explode, dealing the damage between all enemies.
[/list]

[h1][b]New Manufacturer: Zuse [/b][/h1]
Zuse focuses on cutting-edge tech for Light Shield and Light Armor.
[list]
[*] Upgrades for Light Armor that deal damage on dodge.
[*] Upgrades for Light Armor that heal on taking damage.
[/list]

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Hacker ability Overcharge reduced max shield regen to 50% of shields.
[*] Engineer’s Detonate Charger ability divides generated shields between allies.
[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Soldier’s Magentronc bomb calculating damage incorrectly.
[*] Fixed an issue with Cyberninja’s Assassinate calculating damage incorrectly.
[*] Fixed an issue with Hacker’s Memory Leak effect calculating damage incorrectly.
[*] Deploy Bolty tooltip clarified to indicate he can only be deployed once per battle.
[*] Fixed an issue wherein previewing an ability could display incorrect values.
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon…[/b]
[list]
[*] Focus on: The Void Psyker!
[*] Next Campaign Mission: Triangulatin. (It’s a comin!)
[*] More cool stuff!
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 8/28
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Focus On: The Smuggler![/b][/h1]

LET’S ROLL THE DICE! The Smuggler ability trees have been modified and completed based on feedback and suggestions. Thanks everyone who has been submitting feedback and bug reports - as always, please let us know what you think!

[h1][b]Dirty Moves[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Explosive trap deals increased damage and Stuns the mob that triggers it.
[*] Holo trap has an increased trigger chance and deals damage when it triggers.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Kalmonri Trap - deploy a decoy that Taunts, deals damage when attacked, and has a chance to confuse enemies when struck.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Trap Card - Passive - Automatically deploy traps when combat begins.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Bag of Wonders - rummage around and throw down a random artifact from your stash. Will it do something positive for your team? Will it do something terrible to the enemy? WHO KNOWS!
[/list]

[h1][b]Gunslinger[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Akimbo - now attacks the target and a random second target for increased damage. Your Shoot ability now attacks a target with both weapons, instead of also attacking a random second target.
[*] Push Yer Luck - no longer has a chance to overheat and Stun the Smuggler, instead each use increases chance to inadvertently Taunt all enemies with your flashy gunplay. Showoff.
[*] Trick Shot - deals increased damage and now bounces a set number of times with increased critical chance. At max rank, gains critical hit chance with each bounce.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Fan The Hammers - Passive - Gain damage and crit chance with every Gunslinger ability you use. Every 3rd ability used reduces the Time Unit cost of the next.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Buddy Shield - Hide behind your highest health ally, reducing incoming damage and splitting it with the ally. Threat generated by the Smuggler is redirected to your ally. At max rank, patch up your buddy if their health drops low. The better to soak bullets.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Showdown - Score critical hits to add charges to Showdown. Each use increases the cooldown and max number of charges Showdown can hold for the remainder of the mission. Activate to shoot all the bullets!
[/list]

[h1][b]Cheap Tricks[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Coin Toss - reduced bonus damage from Heads and increased Time Unit reduction.
No longer requires a ranged weapon. Bad Luck strikes only enemies at max rank.
[*] Mug - no longer gives credits based on mob level but now also has a special set of valuable items the Smuggler can steal. Weapons, shield, and armor items  can still be stolen.
[*] Bounty - now costs a fixed amount of credits that grows with each use in battle, no longer increases Smuggler dodge at max rank but increases chance to critically hit target.
[*] Roulette - now deals a straight multiplier of weapon damage and gains crit chance with each spin. At max rank, also gains additional damage with each spin.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Ante Up - Passive - with each credit you spend in combat, gain a stacking critical hit bonus and recoup some of your spent credits at the end of combat. At max rank, also grant a random ally a stacking damage buff.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Double Down - activate to deal a random amount of damage, max possible damage increases each time you get a success from Coin Toss, Mug, or Roulette.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Slot Machine - Do you like RNG? Pull the lever and see what happens!
[/list]

[h1][b]Item & Mechanic Changes[/b][/h1]
We’re testing these new mechanics for Stun, Armor and Shields, so let us know what you think!

[list]
[*] Stun resist has arrived for mobs. After getting feedback on Stuns, we’d like them to be punchier overall but prevent control teams from locking down without any fear of retaliation. Each time a mob is Stunned, they gain a stacking 20% resistance to further stuns for 5 turns.

[*] Armor now reduces a percentage of incoming damage instead of a flat amount.
Player armor (damage reduction and dodge) will degrade in effectiveness as character level exceeds armor level at roughly 25% reduction every level after a 3 level difference.
Rare, Epic and Legendary armor has a boost to the percentage absorbed and the rate at which it degrades due to level is decreased, allowing it to remain effective longer.

[*] Shields now block crits against mobs and players as long as there is at least 1 charge.
Shields now reduce a percentage of incoming damage instead of a flat amount.
Player shields will degrade in effectiveness as character level exceeds shield level at roughly 25% reduction every level after a 3 level difference.
Rare, Epic and Legendary shields have a boost to the percentage they absorb and the rate at which they degrade due to level is decreased, allowing them to remain effective longer.

[*] Armor and Shield damage reduction work together additively based on original incoming damage. Ex: Hardslab is hit with 100 points of damage. His shield absorbs 50% and his armor 15%. Hardslab suffers 100 - 50 - 15 = 35 points of damage.

[*] Armor and Shields from previous builds will convert to the new system when loading a save.
[/list]

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Hacker ability Overcharge adjusted to work with new shield mechanics.
[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the light puzzle on the mission Good Housekeeping that could prevent the final boss fight and mob spawns from triggering correctly.[*] Fixed a nasty bug with room updating during combat that lead to a bunch of other problems.
[*] Fixed an issue where breaking mob shields caused increased threat.
[*] Fixed a display issue with upgrades and weapon mods that increase initiative.
[*] Fixed an Aurora rep title typo in mission Good Housekeeping.
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon…[/b]
[list]
[*] Focus on: The Void Psyker!
[*] Focus on: The Force Psyker!
[*] Next Campaign Mission: Triangulatin.
[*] More cool stuff!
[/list]
