notes.title: Patch Notes 8/14/2015
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Focus On: The Engineer![/b][/h1]

HARR! The Engineer ability trees have been modified and completed based on feedback and suggestions. Thanks everyone who has been submitting feedback and bug reports! This is a major overhaul for the Engineer class so, as always, let us know what you think!

[h1]Engineer Class Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Junk no longer needs to be collected during combat with gathering abilities. Engineers begin combat with 5 Junk and can spend it to summon constructs, unlock abilities, and empower attacks. After spending Junk, it typically regenerates at a rate of 1 per end of turn.
[*] Constructs are much faster to deploy, deal more damage, and are more fragile.
[*] The Grease Monkey tree has been reworked into the Rigger tree and focuses on making field expedient upgrade to the Engineer’s rig and using experimental weapons and gadgets to support the team both offensively and defensively.
[*] Bolty has found a job as a tanking and control pet. Bolty abilities now unlock and activate on the same turn.
[/list]

[h1][b]Constructor[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Junker no longer collects Junk and instead spews noxious fumes at all enemies. He can be commanded to Taunt all enemies as before.
[*] Blasto has significantly improved single target damage which gets stronger the longer it spends attacking the same target.
[*] Thumper has moved up the tree and deals AOE damage.
[*] Charger now saps shields in addition to building up shield charges. Max shield charges reduced, damaged increased, removed purge and interrupt at max rank.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Twofer - deploys a short-lived duplicate of the next construct you deploy that deals increased damage and refunds Junk immediately upon deconstructing.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Special Delivery - the next construct you summon is stuffed full of explosives.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Master Builder - Reduce the Junk costs of your constructs and boost their damage, health, and damage reduction. You are the special. 
[/list]

[h1][b]Rigger[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Most abilities from the Rigger tree use Junk to unlock but then are free to reuse.
[*]  Until they malfunction...
[*] Pneumato-wrench removed.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Pneumato Fist - use Junk to power up and fire your Pneumato Fist, punching foes in the face remotely. Each strike stacks critical hit chance against the target.
[*] NEW ABILITY : QwikStop - Boost team damage and accuracy at the start of battle by  a large amount and permanently by a smaller amount.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Rumble Pak - Repeated use builds damage and Slows enemies, and probably drains your battery too. Use with caution.
[*] Removed Junkerbluss.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Railgun - fire a piece of Junk through the target. Railgun cannot penetrate shields but pierces armor.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Ornery (passive) - boost Engineer health and resistance to Stun.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Overshield - use junk to power up your Overshield, redirecting party damage to the Engineer and reducing it by a large amount. Builds critical hit when it absorbs damage.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Upgrade! After scoring a critical hit, get inspired and convert a piece of Junk into a permanent damage upgrade to the team for the remainder of battle. Also makes your Rigger abilities cheaper and better.
[/list]

[h1][b]Bolty[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Bolty abilities now unlock and use on the same turn, resetting if there is malfunction.
[*] Deploy Bolty - now deploys at start of combat at Rank 3, reduced max health, damage and no longer creates Junk when attacking. Bolty now deals increased threat and has 10% dodge.
[*] Rocket Elbow - boosted damage and reduced malfunction. Malfunction targets enemies.
[*] Gun Arm is now Stafe - attacks each enemy for weapon damage. Malfunction stuns an enemy.
[*] Shotblocker - reduced initial duration, malfunction and now gives Bolty damage caused and damage taken reduction. Max rank grants 30% dodge.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Built Real Good - Passively gives damage reduction and increases damage output, once per battle Bolty gets an emergency heal if his health is low. Berseks when crit.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Power Drain - Sap a large amount of shields to give Bolty damage reduction.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Mr. Autoroboto - Allow Bolty to choose his own actions in combat, giving him access to all unlocked Bolty abilities. They do not need to be equipped and consume 0 Junk. :O
[/list]


[h1][b]Changes & Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] NEW Manufacturer : Bravura - focuses on flashy, high threat weapons for tanks with bonuses for Heavy weapons and Heavy subtypes..
[*] NEW Manufacturer : Siyama - loves to make weapons with Thunder, Acid, Fire and Ice.
[/list]

[b]Thanks you to everyone who has been playing and submitting bug reports and feedback![/b]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Save00 may not show on Save / Load menu.
[*] Fixed an issue with character name input fields not recognizing capital characters.
[*] Fixed an issue where some abilities and effects were playing sounds incorrectly.
[*] Fixed an issue where Hacker’s Root Hack could cause mobs to gain threat on each other. 
[*] Fixed an issue where a combo of Cyberninja abilities could deal negative damage.
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon…[/b]
[list]
[*] Focus on: The Smuggler!
[*] New manufacturers for weapons, armor and shields.
[*] Next Campaign Mission: Triangulatin.
[*] New NPC art.
[*] More cool stuff!
[/list]

[*] The Grease Monkey tree has been reworked into the Rigger tree and focuses on making field expedient upgrade to the Engineer’s rig and using experimental weapons and gadgets to support the team both offensively and defensively.
[*] Bolty has found a job as a tanking and control pet. Bolty abilities now unlock and activate on the same turn.
[/list]

[h1][b]Constructor[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Junker no longer collects Junk and instead spews noxious fumes at all enemies. He can be commanded to Taunt all enemies as before.
[*] Blasto has significantly improved single target damage which gets stronger the longer it spends attacking the same target.
[*] Thumper has moved up the tree and deals AOE damage.
[*] Charger now saps shields in addition to building up shield charges. Max shield charges reduced, damaged increased, removed purge and interrupt at max rank.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Twofer - deploys a short-lived duplicate of the next construct you deploy that deals increased damage and refunds Junk immediately upon deconstructing.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Special Delivery - the next construct you summon is stuffed full of explosives.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Master Builder - Reduce the Junk costs of your constructs and boost their damage, health, and damage reduction. You are the special. 
[/list]

[h1][b]Rigger[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Most abilities from the Rigger tree use Junk to unlock but then are free to reuse.
[*]  Until they malfunction...
[*] Pneumato-wrench removed.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Pneumato Fist - use Junk to power up and fire your Pneumato Fist, punching foes in the face remotely. Each strike stacks critical hit chance against the target.
[*] NEW ABILITY : QwikStop - Boost team damage and accuracy at the start of battle by  a large amount and permanently by a smaller amount.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Rumble Pak - Repeated use builds damage and Slows enemies, and probably drains your battery too. Use with caution.
[*] Removed Junkerbluss.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Railgun - fire a piece of Junk through the target. Railgun cannot penetrate shields but pierces armor.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Ornery (passive) - boost Engineer health and resistance to Stun.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Overshield - use junk to power up your Overshield, redirecting party damage to the Engineer and reducing it by a large amount. Builds critical hit when it absorbs damage.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Upgrade! After scoring a critical hit, get inspired and convert a piece of Junk into a permanent damage upgrade to the team for the remainder of battle. Also makes your Rigger abilities cheaper and better.
[/list]

[h1][b]Bolty[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Bolty abilities now unlock and use on the same turn, resetting if there is malfunction.
[*] Deploy Bolty - now deploys at start of combat at Rank 3, reduced max health, damage and no longer creates Junk when attacking. Bolty now deals increased threat and has 10% dodge.
[*] Rocket Elbow - boosted damage and reduced malfunction. Malfunction targets enemies.
[*] Gun Arm is now Stafe - attacks each enemy for weapon damage. Malfunction stuns an enemy.
[*] Shotblocker - reduced initial duration, malfunction and now gives Bolty damage caused and damage taken reduction. Max rank grants 30% dodge.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Built Real Good - Passively gives damage reduction and increases damage output, once per battle Bolty gets an emergency heal if his health is low. Berseks when crit.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Power Drain - Sap a large amount of shields to give Bolty damage reduction.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Mr. Autoroboto - Allow Bolty to choose his own actions in combat, giving him access to all unlocked Bolty abilities. They do not need to be equipped and consume 0 Junk. :O
[/list]


[h1][b]Changes & Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] NEW Manufacturer : Bravura - focuses on flashy, high threat weapons for tanks with bonuses for Heavy weapons and Heavy subtypes..
[*] NEW Manufacturer : Siyama - loves to make weapons with Thunder, Acid, Fire and Ice.
[/list]

[b]Thanks you to everyone who has been playing and submitting bug reports and feedback![/b]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Save00 may not show on Save / Load menu.
[*] Fixed an issue with character name input fields not recognizing capital characters.
[*] Fixed an issue where some abilities and effects were playing sounds incorrectly.
[*] Fixed an issue where Hacker’s Root Hack could cause mobs to gain threat on each other. 
[*] Fixed an issue where a combo of Cyberninja abilities could deal negative damage.
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon…[/b]
[list]
[*] Focus on: The Smuggler!
[*] New manufacturers for weapons, armor and shields.
[*] Next Campaign Mission: Triangulatin.
[*] New NPC art.
[*] More cool stuff!
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 8/3/2015
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Focus On: The Solider[/b][/h1]

HOOAH! The Soldier ability trees have been modified and completed based on feedback and suggestions. And explosions. Thank you to everyone who has been submitting feedback and bug reports! Sounds and attack effects are still being worked on for some of the new abilities and will be added in a future update. Let us know what you think!

[h1]Soldier Class Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Tactician tanking improved. Getting shot instead of your teammates should now be more viable and enjoyable for the Soldier.
[*] The Demolition tree has a new mechanic at Rank 3 of all Demolition abilities: Bomblets! You’ll be tossing these chaotic explosives onto the battlefield more and more frequently as you progress down the tree. Demo abilities can interact with bomblets in different ways, from blowing them up in place for bonus damage to pulling them towards a particular target.
[*] The Specialist tree has major changes to give more opportunities to get the most out of the different weapon types you find.
[/list]

[h1][b]Tactician[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Meatshield damage dealt and damage reduction improved, Time Unit cost decreased.
[*] Best Defense top-end damage increased, Time Unit cost increased slightly.
[*] Removed Hit the Deck! ability.
[*] Defiance has moved up the tree and now provides a health boost and damage reduction at every rank, in addition to boosting your damage as you absorb hits.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Cry Havoc! Shout at your team to boost their damage if their health is high or reduce damage taken if their health is low. Max rank provides crit chance or a small heal.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Juggernaut - Charge out in front of your team to redirect all the bullets directly to your bod. This obviously makes you want to reflexively shoot back at the enemy immediately.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Bloodthirst - empowers your next damaging action to regenerate some health based on damage dealt. Tanking is thirsty work. 
[*] NEW ABILITY : As One! Shout at your team to fire on your target for increased weapon damage, crit chance, and accuracy.
[/list]

[h1][b]Demolition[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Frag Grenade - improved damage to all targets, reduced TU cost and cooldown.
[*] Rocket Strike - boosted damage and bonuses against target with no Shield, reduced TU cost
[*] Bouncing Betty - boosted damage and jump count, reduced TU cost
[*] Removed Barrage.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Hellfire Salvo - launch all of the rockets onto the battlefield at random, setting enemies on fire and generally wreaking havoc.
[*] NEW ABILITY : UXO - if you’ve got a lot of Bomblets laying around, immediately reduce their trigger timers and boost damage if they explode.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Magnetronc Bomb - Bomblets not landing where you want? Pull them to the targeted enemy and explode with bonus critical chance.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Boom King. Make all of the Bomblets dropped by your Demo abilities deal increased damage and increased critical hit chance. At max rank, you have a chance to throw an extra bomb when Bomblets is activated. You are the Boom King!
[/list]

[h1][b]Specialist[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Crack Shot - reduced accuracy bonus slightly at max rank.
[*] Removed Rapid Reload ability.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Custom Armor - mod your armor based on it’s type to get bonuses. At max rank, seek Corporate Sponsorship by sporting a weapon and armor made by the same manufacturer for increased damage and reduced damage taken. Like a pro!
[*] Mark target renamed Flare - improved accuracy and critical bonuses for team, dodge reduction is now part of all ranks, and flare duration increased.
[*] Overwatch - reduced max number of attacks from Overwatch and removed TU penalty when effects ends. Added bonus effect based on equipped weapon. Now requires at least 1 other team member to be alive to activate.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Hot Streak - every 3rd critical hit adds a stack to Hot Streak, consume 1 stack to deal boosted damage with increased critical chance and critical damage.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Kill Count - score points as you achieve killing blows and boost your critical chance for the duration of the mission,
[*] NEW ABILITY : The Specialist - changes to a different special attack based on your equipped weapon..

[h1][b]Changes & Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Slight reduction to drop rate on Common weapons, armor and shields.
[*] Slight adjustment upwards to weapon generator accuracy ranges for multishot weapon variants.
[/list]

[b]Big thanks to everyone who has been submitting bug reports! We’re burning them down :D[/b]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the Esc menu becoming unresponsive if trying to Exit to Title or Quit to OS during new game character creation mode.
[*] Prototype Target Lock can only be active on 1 target at a time.
[*] Target Lock now properly resolves if the target dies unexpectedly before the effect expires.
[*] Target Lock no longer shows the Snubbed debuff for your team in addition to enemies.
[*] Cyberninja Ricochet was calculating and applying damage incorrectly when used on enemies.
[*] Cyberninja Combo Strike was using an incorrect Time Unit for the initial attack.
[*] Hacker Logic Bomb was applying periodic damage incorrectly.
[*] Hacker Hotlink, Logic Bomb, and Overheat abilities were displaying damage and duration incorrectly in their effect descriptions in combat.
[*] Fixed an issue with Bolty’s Hand Cannon that could cause combat to halt the turn order.
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon…[/b]
[list]
[*] Focus on: The Engineer!
[*] New manufacturers for weapons, armor and shields.
[*] Next Campaign Mission: Triangulatin.
[*] New NPC art.
[*] More cool stuff!
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 7/29/2015
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Focus On: The Prototype![/b][/h1]

GREETINGS, MEATBAGS. The Prototype ability trees have been modified and completed based on feedback and suggestions. The malfunction mechanic for the Prototype has been redesigned - it no longer interrupts your turn and instead curses you with a delightful array of status effects (both good and bad). Let us know what you think!

[h1]Prototype Class Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Malfunctions no longer mean the Prototype just misses their turn. A lot. They now add attribute modifiers and other effects that persist until you reach a hard limit, then the Prototype is Stunned while you Shutdown to recover. Malfunctions reset between missions but persist between battles.
[*] Certain abilities benefit from having malfunctions, others from avoiding their accumulation, and some use them as a resource to power the ability.
[/list]

[h1][b]Annihilation[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Arm Cannon has moved to the top of the tree and has a reduced malfunction rate.
[*] Thunderclap damage increased and has a reduced malfunction rate.
[*] Haiku Module is now Haiku.exe. Debuffs from a negative poem only last 1 turn.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Hunter Killer (Passive) Gain a flat damage boost which is reduced by your accumulated malfunctions. Enter Stealth automatically when you Shutdown.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Safety Protocol - switch off the safety and gain damage and crit boosts every turn, as long as you don’t malfunction.
[*] NEW ABILITY : R.A.M - clear malfunctions and go BERSERK increasing damage for several turns and empowering your Arm Cannon and Thunderclap abilities. Then take a nap.
[/list]

[h1][b]Termination[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] NEW ABILITY : Demean has moved to the top of the tree - Taunt a foe mercilessly and reduce the damage they deal to the Prototype.
[*] Get Down. - reduced Stun on ally, increased damage reduction, reduced Time Unit cost.
[*] Aegis Mode - increased damage, reduced Time Unit cost significantly.
[*] Reason - increased damage, reduced Time Unit cost. Attacks once per enemy target and has a chance to apply Daze instead of Stun, Rank 3 Confuses damaged targets for 1 turn.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Relentless (Passive) - regenerate health when you malfunction. On Shutdown, Taunt all enemies and take reduced damage.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Termination Mode - clear malfunctions and reconstruct yourself. Gains bonus healing from cleared malfunction and getting killed just makes you really mad.
[/list]

[h1][b]Mutation[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Integration tree renamed Mutation and is all about stacking malfunctions. And rampaging.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Chaotic Shot / Strike - replaces Precision. Gains critical hit, malfunction chance, and loses accuracy with repeated use. Bonuses reset when Stunned.
[*] Assault - no longer changes based on equipped weapon but always adds bonus attacks, reduces Time Unit cost, and increases malfunction chance. Rank 3 adds bonus attacks when combat begins. Bonuses reset when you malfunction.
[*] Core Dump - damage increased and now dumps all charges when activated. Rank 3 deals bonus damage to all other targets.
[*] Kill Cone - reduced accuracy and increased malfunction chance. Rank 3 now resets the cooldown if a target is killed by your Kill Cone.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Mut.exe - swap out your malfunctions for new ones and keep the positive effects from swapped malfunctions as a buff. Rank 3 heals you for each swapped malfunction.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Chaos Model - boost damage for every malfunction you accumulate and reduce the Stun duration from Shutdown.
[*] NEW ABILITY : H.A.M - clear your malfunctions and go nuts. 

[h1][b]Changes & Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Added combat tooltips to Void Energy, Force Energy, Junk, and Malfunction widgets.
[*] Rank 3 of abilities (for Hacker, Cyberninja, and Prototype) can be previewed on tooltips.
[*] Prototype Target Lock no longer prevents targeting enemies that are not the object of their obsession, but instead reduces damage caused to other enemies. Damage and duration boosted.
[*] Hacker’s Virus: Hotlink stacks now properly divides the boost among your team instead of applying the entire boost to each team member.
[*] Memory footprint optimization and under-the-hood improvements.
[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with effects not updating when a Stunned character takes their turn.
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon…[/b]
[list]
[*] Focus on: The Soldier!
[*] New Campaign Mission: Triangulatin.
[*] New NPC art.
[*] More cool stuff!

notes.title: Patch Notes 7/20/2015
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Focus On: The Cyberninja![/b][/h1]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/318970/discussions/0/611701360818631847/][b]Latest Hotfix Notes![/b][/url]

Hello! The Cyberninja ability trees have been modified and completed based on feedback and suggestions. Sounds and attack effects are still being worked on for some of the new abilities and will be added in a future update. It should now be easier and more desirable to build and use Combo Points to perforate your foes.

[h1]Cyberninja Class Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Combo Points are faster to accrue. The Combo Point visual has been reworked to make it easier to identify and shows continually during combat, per user request.
[*] Abilities that deal damage through Combo Point use have increased damage.
[*] The Tempest tree has been renamed Deception and focuses on a mix of Stealth-based, AoE and debuff attacks. Most Deception abilities gain an added benefit or effect if the Cyberninja has entered Stealth prior to executing them.
[*] The melee weapon requirement for some Cyberninja abilities has been removed.
[/list]

[b]Combination[/b]
[list]
[*] Rank 3 of most Combination abilities now apply Setup, a stacking accuracy buff.
[*] Combo Strike has been redesigned to build Combo Points when your allies attack the same target. It also consumes Combo Points if the target already has some.
[*] Flipkick damage increased.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Ricochet replaces Wheel Kick. Dazes the next character in the timeline and inflicts bonus damage if they have Combo Points - does not consume Combo Points.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Ambush replaces Setup. Provides a Combo Point 100% of the time when the Cyberninja or an ally dodges, but only triggers a limited number of times per turn.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Purging Blow - Visuals Not Yet Implemented - consume Combo Points to purge a buff effect from the target. If a buff is purged, the target takes increased damage.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Laserchain Kunai - Impale a target with Combo Points to drag them forward in the timeline. Dragged enemies that are pulled past an ally take damage. If you pull the enemy next to you, Laserchain Kunai costs no time units. Get over here!
[*] NEW ABILITY : Takedown - Visuals Not Yet Implemented - Attack a target multiple times for each Combo Point and boost damage for every stack of Setup they have.
[/list]

[b]Assassination[/b]
[list]
[*] Vicious Strike renamed to Kougeki and has improved Combo Point generation. 
[*] Deadly Focus has boosted passive effects and always generates a Combo Point on a crit.
[*] Expose Weakness has improved damage at Rank 1. Reduced time unit cost to 50% weapon speed and boosted strength of all effects. Heavy Weapon specialization now applies a Slow.
[*] Flurry time unit cost reduced and base damage from Combo Points increased.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Phase Binder - strike quickly to increase accuracy of your attacks against the target and teleport in front of them in the timeline.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Nanite Toxin - poison targets with a long-lasting toxin that inflicts damage based on the max health of the target and adds Combo Points when it causes damage.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Assassinate - Brutal damage increased for every Cyberninja debuff on the target if their health is low. At max rank, Assassinate resets the cooldowns on your abilities.
[/list]

[b]Deception[/b]
[list]
[*] NEW ABILITY : Vanish - slip into the shadows to gain Stealth, add Combo Points to a target, and boost the damage of your next attack. Stealth prevents enemies directly targeting the Cyberninja and can be used to empower Deception abilities.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Stalk - if already in Stealth, Vanish becomes Stalk. Consumes Combo Points to increase damage against the stalked target and move you in front of them in the timeline.
[*] Dash no longer requires a melee weapon. If Dashing from Stealth, your dodge chance is greatly increased for several turns.
[*] Falling Rain no longer requires a melee weapon, base damage increased and damage is boosted if attacking from Stealth. Rank 3 provides a stacking increase to damage taken.
[*] Eye of the Storm has increased base damage and no longer applies Combo Points. If made from Stealth, the central target is blinded for a large amount.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Concealing Mists - provide all allies with a large boost to their dodge chance. When they dodge an attack, the boost is reduced and the target gains a Combo Point.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Shadowfall - Blind all enemies for every Combo Point on them and retaliate when they miss an attack. If made from Stealth, attacks from Shadowfall return you to Stealth.
[/list]

[h1][b]Changes & Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Prototype Target Lock no longer prevents targeting enemies that are not the object of obsession, but reduces damage caused to other enemies. Damage and duration boosted.
[*] Reduced strength of Slow effect applied by Hacker’s Virus: Hotlink stacks.
[*] Base accuracy reduced for most enemies, specific enemies may have higher or lower accuracy.
[*] The droprate on melee weapons has been boosted slightly.
[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 7/20/2015
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Focus On: The Cyberninja![/b][/h1]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/318970/discussions/0/611701360818631847/][b]Latest Hotfix Notes![/b][/url]

Hello! The Cyberninja ability trees have been modified and completed based on feedback and suggestions. Sounds and attack effects are still being worked on for some of the new abilities and will be added in a future update. It should now be easier and more desirable to build and use Combo Points to perforate your foes.

[h1]Cyberninja Class Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Combo Points are faster to accrue. The Combo Point visual has been reworked to make it easier to identify and shows continually during combat, per user request.
[*] Abilities that deal damage through Combo Point use have increased damage.
[*] The Tempest tree has been renamed Deception and focuses on a mix of Stealth-based, AoE and debuff attacks. Most Deception abilities gain an added benefit or effect if the Cyberninja has entered Stealth prior to executing them.
[*] The melee weapon requirement for some Cyberninja abilities has been removed.
[/list]

[b]Combination[/b]
[list]
[*] Rank 3 of most Combination abilities now apply Setup, a stacking accuracy buff.
[*] Combo Strike has been redesigned to build Combo Points when your allies attack the same target. It also consumes Combo Points if the target already has some.
[*] Flipkick damage increased.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Ricochet replaces Wheel Kick. Dazes the next character in the timeline and inflicts bonus damage if they have Combo Points - does not consume Combo Points.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Ambush replaces Setup. Provides a Combo Point 100% of the time when the Cyberninja or an ally dodges, but only triggers a limited number of times per turn.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Purging Blow - Visuals Not Yet Implemented - consume Combo Points to purge a buff effect from the target. If a buff is purged, the target takes increased damage.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Laserchain Kunai - Impale a target with Combo Points to drag them forward in the timeline. Dragged enemies that are pulled past an ally take damage. If you pull the enemy next to you, Laserchain Kunai costs no time units. Get over here!
[*] NEW ABILITY : Takedown - Visuals Not Yet Implemented - Attack a target multiple times for each Combo Point and boost damage for every stack of Setup they have.
[/list]

[b]Assassination[/b]
[list]
[*] Vicious Strike renamed to Kougeki and has improved Combo Point generation. 
[*] Deadly Focus has boosted passive effects and always generates a Combo Point on a crit.
[*] Expose Weakness has improved damage at Rank 1. Reduced time unit cost to 50% weapon speed and boosted strength of all effects. Heavy Weapon specialization now applies a Slow.
[*] Flurry time unit cost reduced and base damage from Combo Points increased.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Phase Binder - strike quickly to increase accuracy of your attacks against the target and teleport in front of them in the timeline.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Nanite Toxin - poison targets with a long-lasting toxin that inflicts damage based on the max health of the target and adds Combo Points when it causes damage.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Assassinate - Brutal damage increased for every Cyberninja debuff on the target if their health is low. At max rank, Assassinate resets the cooldowns on your abilities.
[/list]

[b]Deception[/b]
[list]
[*] NEW ABILITY : Vanish - slip into the shadows to gain Stealth, add Combo Points to a target, and boost the damage of your next attack. Stealth prevents enemies directly targeting the Cyberninja and can be used to empower Deception abilities.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Stalk - if already in Stealth, Vanish becomes Stalk. Consumes Combo Points to increase damage against the stalked target and move you in front of them in the timeline.
[*] Dash no longer requires a melee weapon. If Dashing from Stealth, your dodge chance is greatly increased for several turns.
[*] Falling Rain no longer requires a melee weapon, base damage increased and damage is boosted if attacking from Stealth. Rank 3 provides a stacking increase to damage taken.
[*] Eye of the Storm has increased base damage and no longer applies Combo Points. If made from Stealth, the central target is blinded for a large amount.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Concealing Mists - provide all allies with a large boost to their dodge chance. When they dodge an attack, the boost is reduced and the target gains a Combo Point.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Shadowfall - Blind all enemies for every Combo Point on them and retaliate when they miss an attack. If made from Stealth, attacks from Shadowfall return you to Stealth.
[/list]

[h1][b]Changes & Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Prototype Target Lock no longer prevents targeting enemies that are not the object of obsession, but reduces damage caused to other enemies. Damage and duration boosted.
[*] Reduced strength of Slow effect applied by Hacker’s Virus: Hotlink stacks.
[*] Base accuracy reduced for most enemies, specific enemies may have higher or lower accuracy.
[*] The droprate on melee weapons has been boosted slightly.
[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Cyberninja Rolling Thunder resulting in a negative effect if triggering not on the Cyberninja’s turn.
[*] Fixed an issue with Prototype’s Target Lock that sometimes caused combat to halt.
[*] Fixed an issue with Prototype’s Target Lock not reducing time unit cost if Prototype scores a deathblow on the target.
[*] Fixed an issue with Steam overlay interfering with Continue / Load button activation.
[*] Fixed an issue with scrolling on the Save / Load menus.
[*] Fixed issue of custom text on Save game input field being limited to name formatting.
[*] Fixed issue with Combo Points being offset incorrectly on certain enemies.
[*] Fixed an issue with Engineer’s Charger incorrectly calculating action cost.
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon…[/b]
[list]
[*] Focus On: The Prototype
[*] Improvements to the Prototype Malfunction mechanic
[*] New Campaign Mission: Triangulatin.
[*] New NPC art.
[*] More cool stuff!

notes.title: Patch Notes 7/10/15
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Focus On: The Hacker![/b][/h1]

The Hacker ability trees have been modified and completed based on feedback and suggestions. Sounds are still being worked on for most of the new abilities. Check them out and let us know what you think!

[b] Rootkit[/b]
[list]
[*] Virus: Overheat has been redesigned for on-demand CC that grows each turn.
[*] System Shock now also provides Hackuracy, increasing your accuracy with each shot fired or attack made with Shoot or Strike.
[*] Scramble has been redesigned as a fast interrupt and Confuse that doubles the effect of a Stun at max rank.
[*] Root Hack now has a chance to break each turn instead of being resisted outright and breaks immediately if the target has no allies to attack.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Cripple - convert Stun on a target into a powerful and long lasting Slow.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Exploit - target takes increased damage for every point of Slow.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Snowcrash - afflict all targets with Snowcrash, causing them to infect themselves with a new CC effect every turn.
[/list]

[b]Malware[/b]
[list]
[*] Virus: Mindmelt now stacks damage and duration.
[*] Shareware has an increased chance to spread your viruses and adds a bonus virus (Memory Leak) when it spreads.
[*] Small increase to Corruption damage per turn and no longer improves crit chance on target but boosts all damage taken while Corruption is active.
[*] Small increase to Logic Bomb damage per turn.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Degrade - increases crit chance on target and critical hits apply a permanent crit chance boost to attacks against the target.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Black Ice - constructs a Black Ice out of stray nanites which casts Virus: Mindmelt on enemies.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Kill Switch - updates and then explodes all virus effects on all targets. 
Pixel fireworks!
[/list]

[b]Optimization[/b]
[list]
[*] Rank 3 of most Optimization abilities provides a stacking buff to team damage.
[*] Virus: Hotlink now Slows enemies and Hastes allies for a normalized amount of Time Units.
[*] Overlock no longer Slows the affected ally but insteads buffs their speed for 1 turn.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Multi Core - boosts damage caused and reduces damage taken for every buff effect on each ally. 
[*] NEW ABILITY : Overcharge - restores team shields and boosts shield absorb.
[*] NEW ABILITY : Ex Machina - attempts to activate all unlocked abilities from the Optimization tree on all allies. [b]ALL OF THE BUFFS.[/b]
[/list]

[h1][b]Changes & Improvements[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Ability Point notification popup can now be clicked for a shortcut to the Ability menu.
[*] Many buttons (ex: tutorias) can be dismissed / accepted with ESC/Space/ Return.
[*] Save System - interface cleaned up with improved save management and unlimited saves. Legacy saves from previous versions are still supported.
[*] Save System - to avoid item collection exploits, quitting the game or exiting to title during a mission will no longer autosave. Aborting a mission continues to autosave and fail the mission.
[*] Autosave - no longer triggers periodically on a mission.
[/list]

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with sound effects on multishot weapons.
[*] Fixed an audio glitch with Hacker’s System Shock ability.
[*] Fixed issue with Smuggler’s Bounty ability preventing combat from continuing.
[*] Fixed issue with Hacker’s Logic Bomb ability sometimes preventing combat from continuing.
[*] Fixed issue with preventing mission progress on Good Housekeeping by getting locked down.
[*] Fixed an issue with pressure plates not showing their disarmed texture.
[*] Fixed a few typos.
[*] Fixed an issue with input fields in Unity offsetting their carets when selected.
[*] Fixed menu display issues at different resolutions.
[*] Fixed an issue where mousing over an enemy battle icon would fail to display their targeter.
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon…[/b]
[list]
[*] Focus On: The Cyberninja!
[*] New Campaign Mission: The Ship Job.
[*] New NPC art.
[*] More cool stuff!

[h1][b]HAVE THE GREATEST WEEKEND[/b][/h1]

notes.title: Patch Notes 6/19/15
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Mission 03 - Good Housekeeping is here![/b][/h1]

This mission starts to showcase the impact of your choices as you choose to run for Horizon, Aurora or Workers United. Depending on how you’ve been playing so far, they’ll all have different opinions about working with you, and have different information and resources to put at your disposal to complete the mission. Get ready to dig into the branching story paths!

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/h1]

[b]Mob Loot[/b]
[list]
[*] All mobs now have a chance to drop loot items after combat. 
[*] Rare and Boss mobs can drop unique items.
[*] The collective levels of your party & Treasure Find items decrease the chance of Common items and increase the chance of Rare/Epic/Legendary items.
[/list]

[b]Weapon Generation[/b]
[list]
[*] The minimum accuracy a weapon can be created with is now 65%. 
[*] The maximum accuracy a weapon can created with is now 90%. 
[*] Manufacturers and weapon mods can adjust these further.
[*] In prep for economy overhaul, weapon, armor and shield values have been reduced significantly.
[/list]

[b]Item Generation[/b]
[list]
[*] New utility items have been added to loot tables.
[*] 30+ New accessories added with new modifiers: Exp Gain, Treasure Find, Stun Resist, and more.
[/list]

[b]Info Log[/b]
Reputation has been overhauled in preparation for future additions and new storyline pathing based on rep. Now you can see what corps are part of a larger faction, and how changing your rep with a member corp will influence how their faction feels about you collectively.

[b]Mail System v1.0[/b]
Receive mail on and between missions that can contain credits and items.
Corps that love you or hate you will also let you know via mail.

[b]Ability Point notification[/b]
If you have unspent points, a friendly reminder will pop up. Don’t forget to put those points in!

[h1][b]FIXES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Aborting or wiping on a mission will properly remove quest items from inventory.
[*] Fixed an issue where upgrading an item could cause it to become corrupted.
[*] Fixed an issue where inspecting a piece of gear with a broken upgrade would duplicate and overwrite the item to the inspectors armor.
[*] Fixed an issue where loading a game with broken item upgrades could cause their bonuses to not be applied.
[*] Fixed an issue where loading certain items could cause their icons to not be recreated.
[*] Fixed an issue where adjusting FOV could cause a crash to desktop.
[*] Lots of tiny fixes and quality of life improvements.
[*] Added Sly Bimlay to the game.
[/list]

As always, we look forward to your feedback and thank you for your support!

notes.title: Patch Notes for 5/19/15
notes.notes:
Latest hotfix notes [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/318970/discussions/0/611701360818631847/]here![/url]

A minor update with some big news - StarCrawlers is going to [url=http://www.momocon.com/]MoMoCon![/url] We're excited to be a top 20 finalist for MoMoCon 2015’s Indie Game Showcase and with Atlanta being only a 4 hour road trip from our current secret base, we’re packing up and heading to the show for May 28th to the 31st. If you’re attending, come say hi and let’s talk StarCrawlers :D

The next big update is still in the works - Mission 03 brings alot of new content! 
In the meantime, let’s set some stuff on fire:

[h1]NEW[/h1] Weapon upgrades are appearing! We’re testing a number of upgrades in this build, keep an eye out for fire, thunder, freezing, acid effects and more on Uncommon+ weapons. This is the test flight for more in-depth item upgrades, so there are (currently) no limitations set on what upgrade can appear on what item type. Have fun and let us know what you think!
Bonus points if you generate a [url=https://pbs.twimg.com/media/CFY23qQVEAEX4Vo.jpg]legendary scoped shiv...[/url]

[h1]NEW[/h1] UI Audio has arrived. More sound effects are in the works…

[h1]Feature Requests[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added FOV settings under Esc Menu -> Graphics
[*] Added Vsynch toggle under Esc Menu -> Graphics
[*] Tooltips for items and gear comparison improved approximately 1000%.
[*] Mission rep changes now show your current rep with a faction.
[*] Upgrade station and merchant interface improved.
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where player would sometimes be forced to repeat a move command upon exiting an event pop up.
[*] Fixed issue where free-look would not trigger correctly if active when an event occurred.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 4/11/15
notes.notes:
Patch Notes for 4/11/15

More content and improvements have arrived!

Our dev roadmap for Early Access can be found [url=http://starcrawlers.com/#DevBlog]here[/url].
The roadmap will be current with every major update - hotfix notes can be found here and on our site forums at [url=www.starcrawlers.com]www.starcrawlers.com[/url].

Found a bug, have a request or just have a question? We’re always on the forums.
[h1]Enjoying the game so far? Consider leaving a review of your experiences![/h1]

[h1]Main Campaign[/h1]
[list]
[*] NEW Campaign mission: The Black Box. Take a trip aboard the Stella Marin in search of answers
[*] Saved games from older builds will have their mission progression reset (don’t worry - your characters and gear are not affected) to make some important decisions on the mission Distressing Signals.
[*] A new vendor is setting up shop on STIX.
[/list]

[h1]Combat[/h1]
[list]
[*] NEW Inspect feature added to combat! Check out all the horrible debuffs you’ve applied to your foes by mousing over their Battle Icons.
[*] NEW Detailed inspect added to combat! Click on a Battle Icon to get a detailed view of the enemy and learn more about them.
[*] NEW Armored foes have started arriving. Get out your Hacker DoTs and Armor debuffs!
[*] Void Psyker’s Horror now has a limit of 8 jumps and will attempt to jump if it kills a target.
[*] Fixed display issue with Horror Void Energy cost.
[*] Cyberninja’s Setup ability can no longer trigger when Cyberninja is dead. Spooky.
[*] Smuggler’s Roulette ability no longer has a chance to complete instantly when activated.
[*] Force Psyker's Fists of Fury ability using a ranged weapon now triggers correctly.
[*] Prototype's Kill Cone ability now correctly has 100% accuracy at Rank 3.
[*] Enemies that channel buff effects on allies can no longer stack them with the same effect from a different caster.
[*] Fixed an issue where Mites Frenzy attack could remove multiple shields from target.
[/list]

[h1]Interface[/h1]
[list]
[*] NEW You can now specify a save game name when saving.
[*] Fixed an issue where xp rewards after combat were displaying incorrectly for parties with varying character levels.
[*] Fixed an issue where Y-look inversion was sometimes not being saved.
[/list]

[list]

[h1]Smuggler[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed ability Lucrative and added ability Bounty.

[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 3/25/15
notes.notes:
StarCrawlers has been in Early Access for just 1 week and already the game has grown so much with your feedback! This update includes a number of player suggestions and improvements along with fixes and improvements. Our first major content update is coming soon - new manufacturers, events, random missions and the next main campaign episode.

Our dev roadmap for Early Access can be found [url=http://starcrawlers.com/#DevBlog]here[/url].
The roadmap will be current with every major update - hotfix notes can be found here and on our site forums at [url=www.starcrawlers.com]www.starcrawlers.com[/url].

[h1]Enjoying the game so far? Consider leaving a review of your experiences![/h1]

[h1]Combat[/h1]
[list]
[*] Xp gains from killing mobs has been rebalanced to take into account the levels of your selected team. Higher level characters receive less kill xp on lower level missions, lower level characters receive bonus xp on higher level missions. 
[*] Increased challenge rating of a mission provides more kill xp.

[*] Engineer pets no longer have a duration and correctly scale their attacks with the Engineer’s weapon damage.
[*] Reduced health for Engineer pets as they no longer have a duration
[*] Engineer junk meter now correctly displays when the Engineer’s turn starts and the correct amount of Junk.

[*] Fixed an issue where Hacker’s Corruption would not cause periodic damage at the start of the enemy turn.

[*] Fixed an issue with Force Psyker’s Barrier effect absorbing damage but allowing a shield to be removed when struck.
[/list]

[h1]Interface[/h1]
[list]
[*] Minimap tiles now draw walls. Secret doors may look like walls...
[*] Exit doors now have a more obvious icon on the minimap.
[*] Mission generator now always creates a few missions (Cakewalk to Easy rating) based on the level of your lowest characters.
[/list]

[h1]Items[/h1]
[list]
[*] The quality of drops in Loot Lockers is now always Uncommon or better, but they no longer drop junk or medkits.
[*] Health kits now heal 20/40/60% health.
[*] Heavy armor now increases the TU cost of all actions.
[*] Shop now always generates at least one weapon, one armor and one shield of common rarity based on the level of your lowest character.
[*] When starting a new game, if you chose to skip the tutorial level, Doc will reward you an Uncommon weapon and some extra credits. For being a badass.
[/list]

[h1]Misc[/h1]
[list]
Reduced damage from gas traps and gas fills rooms more slowly. You have to clog the nozzles.
[/list]

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Patch Notes for 3/20/15
notes.notes:
Welcome to StarCrawlers! 

Our dev roadmap for Early Access can be found [url=http://starcrawlers.com/#DevBlog]here[/url].
The roadmap will be current with every major update - hotfix and patch notes can be found here and on our site forums at [url=www.starcrawlers.com]www.starcrawlers.com[/url].

Enjoying the game so far? Consider leaving a review of your experiences!

[h1]HOTFIX! New improvements on 3/20 [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/318970/discussions/0/611701360818631847/]found here.[/url][/h1]

Based on player feedback and reporting, we've made the following changes:

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] New recruits start with 3 AP to spend. Existing characters will need to visit the medbay and respec to get their extra points. Respeccing returns the correct amount of AP.

[*] Mission rewards scale better with mission challenge rating.

[*] Mission challenge rebalanced and now has a larger impact on mob hp and damage.

[*] Game difficulty setting rebalanced and now has a larger impact on mob hp and damage.

[*] Boosted min / max damage range slightly on pistols.

[*] Added new manufacturer: Auroch. Because missing sucks. Makes weapons with increased accuracy and armor with increased dodge. Reduced damage on non-melee weapons.

[*] The merchant now sells items of levels picked randomly from all recruited crawlers.
[/list]

[b]Interface[/b]
[list]
[*] Quit menu option when in town is now Save & Quit (updates autosave).

[*] Quitting the game at any point updates your autosave and Player Preferences. Quitting while on a mission will fail the mission.

[*] Fixed an issue where players could accidently discard equipped items, causing targeting errors in combat (thanks sliddi and Mumbles!)

[*] Fixed AutoCipher option showing on trap panels when no AutoCiphers are in inventory.
[/list]

[b]Combat[/b]
[list]
[*] Combat speed increased overall. Adjustments are ongoing.

[*] Fixed an issue where an Overloading Void Psyker could prevent battle from continuing if they died while exploding. (thanks Istvan!)

[*] Force Psyker’s Warden’s Wrath ability can no longer be used with Barriers that have 0 health. (thanks rjafarrow!)
[/list]

[b]Enviornment[/b]
[list]
[*] Plugging of holes that leaked out into spaaaaace!

[*] Prevented docking with certain large pieces of machinery.
[/list]

notes.title: Premature Evaluation: StarCrawlers
notes.notes:
Each week Marsh Davies plunders the ravaged hulk of Early Access and smuggles out any stories he can find and/or succumbs to the terrors of the interdimensional void. This week he murders robotic wait staff and asset-strips sci-fi dungeons in space salvage RPG StarCrawlers. It goes on sale tomorrow.

Is it any wonder that some members of the gaming community nurse a persecution complex when, in the games themselves, so few people, animals, robots, or multifanged amorphous spacethings are ever pleased to see us? In StarCrawlers, even the cleaning droids and busboys want to have a pop, lobbing chinaware and squirting me with detergent. Admittedly, I am usually there to plunder their derelict spacestation, or sabotage their data centres, or deliver a severance package to a megacorp employee who has, in a literal and shortly rectified sense, outlived his usefulness. But still, it is a bit of a hit to the self-esteem that you can t walk from one room to another without some haywire robot or grotesque alien hatchling flinging itself at you. Where s the beef? , I mutter to the hatchlings, as I ruefully sunder them with psychic horror channelled from the abyssal nightmare of the void.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Patch 3/11/15
notes.notes:
Wow thanks everyone for the amazing feedback and bug reporting for day 1 of being on EA! We've crushed bugs and made tweaks - here's the details:

[b]Autosave has arrived![/b]

Coming Soon: Quicksave for on-demand autosave updating.

- Temporarily removed Rogue Chefbots until they are confirmed fixed.

- Minimap zoom preferences, look centering, mouse inversion, and freelook settings persist through sessions and combat / events.

- Ability respec is now just 1 credit for the duration of Beta. Go nuts!

- [b][HOTFIX][/b] Issue with saves not loading correctly should now be resolved.
